cards.audioText:
P: Hongkong Approach, CSN 303, we have been struck by lightning, rear fuselage damaged, right elevator lost, request priority landing and radar vector to final approach.
C: CSN 303, you are No.1 radar will assist you until landing.
Question: Which part of aircraft is damaged?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 香港进近，CSN 303，我们遭到雷击，后机身受损，右升降舵丢失，请求优先着陆并雷达引导至最后进近。
C: CSN 303，你是No. 1，雷达将协助你直至着陆。
问题：航空器哪个部位受损？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Rear fuselage.

cards.audioText:
PIL: CSN3471, ready to depart F for landing, expect a normal landing.
CTL: CSN3471, turn left heading 350 for right base runway 18L.
PIL: Left heading 350, runway 18L, CSN3471.
Q: What was CSN3471 doing prior to the controller's instructions?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：南航3471，准备离开F降落，预计正常着陆。管：南航3471，左转航向350右四边进入跑道18左。飞：左转航向350，跑道18左，南航3471。问：收到管制员指令前南航3471在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engaged in a holding pattern.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, GFA 205, four five kilometers southwest of Wuhan, at 9000 meter. Estimated overhead WUH at one three. Request clearance to cross airway Red 343 at WHA. C: GFA 205, Wuhan Control, cleared to cross Red 343, at WHA at 13 or before, maintain 9000 meters.
Question: when will Gulf air cross red tree for tree?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉管制，GFA 205，位于武汉西南45公里，高度9000米。预计13点过WUH导航台。请求许可在WHA导航台穿越红343航路。管制员（C）：GFA 205，武汉管制许可，在13点或之前于WHA导航台穿越红343航路，保持9000米。问题：GFA 205将在何时穿越红343航路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. No later than 13.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan approach, CCA 101, request return to your airport. Dense smoke reported in the rear cargo hold. C: CCA 101, Roger MAYDAY, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 1200 meters on QNH. Radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
Question: Why did CCA 101 return?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY（遇险紧急），武汉进近，CCA 101，请求返回机场。据报后货舱有浓烟。管制员（C）：CCA 101，收到遇险信号，左转航向090，按QNH（场面气压）下降并保持1200米。雷达引导至36右跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近。问题：CCA 101为何返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due dense smoke in rear cargo hold.
choices: Due dense smoke in avionics bay.
Due dense smoke in rear cargo hold.
choicesZh: 由于航空电子设备舱内有浓烟。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, BAW787, maintaining 8900m, cabin altitude is fluctuating. We are trying to sort it out, standby.
CTL: Roger, BAW787.
PIL: Beijing Control, BAW787, request descent to 6300m, suspect slight pressurization problem.
Q: According to the exchange, what problem did the aircraft probably have?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，英航787，8900米保持，座舱高度表指示波动，我们正在检查，稍等。管：收到，英航787。飞：北京区域，英航787，请求下降到6300米，疑似是轻微增压问题。问：根据对话，飞机可能存在什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Pressurization.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6689, Guangzhou Departure, climb to 2400m, report reaching 1800m.
PIL: Guangzhou Departure, CSN6689, reaching 1800m.
CTL: CSN6689, continue climb to 3600m on standard, turn right direct to CG due traffic.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航6689，广州离场，上升到2400米，到达1800米时报告。飞：广州离场，南航6689，到达1800米。管：南航6689，上升到标准气压3600米，由于活动右转直飞CG。问：根据对话，飞行员正在怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Making a departure.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, maintaining 7500m, heading 110, request 9500m.
CTL: CCA102, negative. 8900m approved. Report reaching 8100m.
PIL: Roger, CCA102.
Q: According to the instruction, at which level should CCA102 report?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，国航102，7500米保持，航向110，请求9500米。管：国航102，不同意。同意8900米，8100米时报告。飞：收到，国航102。问：根据指令，国航102应在哪个高度报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 8100 meters.

cards.audioText:
C: Speed Bird 639 turn left heading 130 to offset your original track. The latest weather forecast reports CBs are prevailing on your route. Fly with caution. After going around them, resume navigation.
P: Turn left 130 to detour CBs, Speed Bird 639.
Q: What does the control instructions to Speed Bird 639 indicate?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：英航639，左转航向130，偏离原航迹。最新气象预报报告你的航路上有大片积雨云，请谨慎飞行，避开天气后，恢复自主领航。飞行员：左转航向130，绕飞积雨云，英航639。问：管制员给英航639的指令预示着什么？
choices: It will turn left to resume its own navigation.
It is expected to meet CBs on its original route.
It will resume its own navigation after left turn.
It will offset its path to encounter CBs.
choicesZh: 飞机将左转，恢复自主领航。
飞机在原航路上将会遇到积雨云。
转向后，飞机将恢复自主领航。
飞机将偏离原航路，并遭遇积雨云。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. It is expected to meet CBs on its original route.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, SIA 9040, we have an indication of severe weather, request offset, 30 kilometers to the right. C: SIA 9040, negative due to the restricted area. You can only deviate to the left.
Question: Why did the controller refuse the pilot's request?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉管制，SIA 9040，我们收到恶劣天气提示，请求右偏30公里。管制员（C）：SIA 9040，因存在限制区域，无法批准。你只能向左偏航。问题：管制员为何拒绝飞行员的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to restricted area.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, bird strike reported by a preceding aircraft.
PIL: Roger, CCA101.
PIL: Tower, CCA101, suspect a balloon to the east of the airport, height about 300m.
CTL: Roger, CCA101, we'll check.
Q: According to the statement, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航101，前方飞机报告鸟击。飞：收到，国航101。飞：塔台，国航101，机场东部疑似有气球，高度大约300米。管：收到，国航101，会进行检查。问：根据陈述，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: There was a kite to the east of the airport.
The aircraft reported an emergency at 300 meters.
There was a balloon to the east of the airport.
choicesZh: 飞机在300米报告紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There was a balloon to the east of the airport.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 5321, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R, taxi with caution, water patches on the taxiway.
P: holding point Runway 36R, roger, water on the taxiway, CSN 5321.
Question: What should CSN 5321 be careful about while taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 5321，继续滑行至Runway 36R等待点，谨慎滑行，滑行道上有积水。
P: Runway 36R等待点，收到，滑行道上有水，CSN 5321。
问题：CSN 5321滑行时应注意什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The taxiway is covered with patches of water.
choices: The taxiway is covered with patches of ice.
The taxiway is covered with patches of water.
The taxiway is covered with patches of fog.
The taxiway is covered with patches of snow.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, Departure, radar contact, cancel SID turn left heading 360, maintain 5400m, expect short delay at that level due crossing traffic.
PIL: Roger. Cancel SID, turn left heading 360 and maintain 5400m, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, traffic is well cleared now, climb to and maintain 6600m.
Q: What should CCA121 do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航121，离场，雷达已识别，取消SID，左转航向360，由于交叉活动保持5400米，预计短时延误。飞：收到。取消SID，左转航向360，保持5400米，国航121。管：国航121，活动没影响，爬升6600米保持。问：国航121接下来应该做什么？
choices: Report clear of traffic and continue climbing.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Climb from 5400 meters to 6600 meters.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3202, Wuhan Control, leaving ten thousand one hundred meters, climb and maintain eleven thousand three hundred meters due to converging traffic. P: Wuhan Control, CSN 3202, unable to climb due to weight, request to descend to and maintain 9500 meters.
Question: what does the controller want the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员（C）：CSN 3202，武汉管制，脱离10100米，因为交通冲突，爬升并保持11300米。飞行员（P）：武汉管制，CSN 3202，因重量原因无法爬升，请求下降并保持9500米。问题：管制员希望飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To climb to and maintain 11300m.

cards.audioText:
PIL: QFA235, holding on taxiway A.
CTL: QFA235, hold short for the departure. You are No.2 after the Airbus 320.
PIL: Holding short, No.2 for departing, QFA235.
CTL: QFA235, line up and wait.
PIL: Lining up, QFA235.
Q: What is the departure sequence for QFA235?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：澳航235，滑翔道A等待。管：澳航235，等待离场。你在空客320后第二个。飞：等待，第二个离场，澳航235。管：澳航235，进入跑道等待。飞：进入跑道，澳航235。问：澳航235的离场顺序是第几？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 201, have you reduced to approach speed? You are gaining on the aircraft ahead of you.
P: AFR 201, unable to reduce speed, we have problem with flaps.
C: AFR 201, go around immediately, turn left heading 140, climb and maintain 4000ft for resequence ILS Runway 23L.
Question: Why can't they reduce to approach speed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: AFR 201，你减至进近速度了吗？你正在接近前方航空器。
P: AFR 201，无法减速，我们的襟翼有问题。
C: AFR 201，立即复飞，左转航向140，爬升并保持4000ft，重新排序实施Runway 23L ILS进近。
问题：他们为什么无法减至进近速度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They can't extend their flaps.
choices: They are coming in too fast.
choicesZh: 他们需要一条更长的跑道。

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, ACA 3428 has intercepted an distress call from CCA 3256, I say again, CCA 3256, double engine failure, forced landing, current position 10 miles east of LAMOT, Over.
C: ACA 3248, roger your relayed MAYDAY for CCA 3256.
Question: What do you learn from the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，ACA 3428截获了CCA 3256的遇险呼叫。我再说一遍，CCA 3256，双发失效，迫降，当前位置在LAMOT以东10 miles，完毕。
C: ACA 3248，已收到你转报的CCA 3256 MAYDAY。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Air China has an emergency.
choices: Air Canada has two engines failed.
choicesZh: 加拿大航空遇到紧急情况。
中国国际航空遇到紧急情况。
加拿大航空有两台发动机失效。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CSN3207, reaching holding point runway 18L, request line up.
CTL: CSN3207, hold short of runway, stop transmitting, Mayday in progress.
PIL: Holding short, CSN3207.
CTL: SIA916, extend downwind one minute to give room for the emergency traffic.
Q: Why the controller ask SIA916 to extend downwind?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：北京塔台，南方3207，跑道18左外等待点，请求上跑道。管制员：南方3207，跑道外等待，停止发话，有遇险航空器。飞行员：跑道外等待，南方3207。管制员：新航916，长三边一分钟，给遇险航空器让路。问：管制员为什么让新航916长三边？
choices: CSN3207 is reaching the holding point.
SIA916 should give space to the distress traffic.
CSN3207 is transmitting on wrong frequency.
choicesZh: 南方3207正在到达外等待点。
新航916需要给遇遇险航空器让路。
南方3207在错误的频率上发话。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. SIA916 should give space to the distress traffic.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, CCA101, ready for departure.
CTL: CCA101, clear for takeoff, maintain runway heading until 1800m, then turn right en-route, contact 126.25.
P: Runway heading 1800m, then turn right, contact 126.25. Clear for takeoff, CCA101.
Q: What is not mentioned in the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，国航101，准备好离场了。管制员：国航101，可以起飞，保持跑道航向至1800米，然后在航路上右转，联系126.25。飞行员：跑道航向直达1800米，然后右转，联系126.25，可以起飞，国航101。问：对话中，没有提及的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Transponder code.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Center, CCA102, request diversion 10 miles left of track due weather.
CTL: CCA102, Beijing, negative to left due restricted area. If able, divert right of track.
PIL: Roger, request diversion up to 30 miles right of track, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, diversion approved, cleared of weather direct to CHG.
Q: Which heading change was available for CCA102?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京管制，国航102，由于天气，请求左偏10海里。管：国航102，北京，由于限飞区不可以。如可能右偏航线。飞：收到，请求右偏30海里，国航102。管：国航102，同意偏航，天气没影响直飞CHG。问：国航102能改变的航向是什么？
choices: Divert left or right of track.
Divert right of track in 30 miles.
Divert no more than 30 miles right of track.
Divert right of track direct to CHG.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Divert no more than 30 miles right of track.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL853, engine NO.3 is overheating, probably due to bird ingestion on takeoff. Request priority landing at runway 36 right.
C: UAL853, runway 36 right is in use. You are number 1.
Question: What do you think will probably happen next?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：美联航853，3号发动机过热，可能原因是起飞时遭鸟击。请求优先着陆跑道36右。管制员：美联航853，跑道36右目前在使用，你是第一个。问：你认为接下来将会发生什么？
choices: They might encounter a bird strike.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. None of the above.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, SIA 105, request holding instructions. C: SIA 105, Control, cleared to hold over WG, maintain 8,400 meters, inbound track 106 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one and one-half minutes, expect further clearance in 10 minutes.
Question: What is the inbound track of the holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：管制，SIA 105，请求等待指令。管制员：SIA 105，管制，许可在WG上空等待，保持8400米，向台航迹106度，左等待，背台飞行时间一分半，预计10分钟后发布进一步许可。问题：等待航线的向台航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 106 degrees.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Tower, CSN 316, maintaining 1200m on the localizer Runway 36L. C: CSN 316, continue approach, traffic two o'clock landing Runway 36R, report traffic in sight. P: continue approach, wilco, CSN 316.
Question: What's the landing runway for the traffic at 2 o'clock?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉塔台，CSN 316，在36L跑道航向道上保持1200米。管制员：CSN 316，继续进近，2点钟方向有航空器在36R跑道着陆，目视该航空器时报告。飞行员：继续进近，照办，CSN 316。问题：2点钟方向的航空器在哪条跑道着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Runway 36R.

cards.audioText:
P: Pierre Tower, ACA 359, Airbus three three zero, we have two tires burst on the right main gear. We are unable to vacate the runway. C: Roger, ACA 359, I will advise aerodrome and assistance will be provided. P: Thank you. We request passenger steps and buses to take the passengers to the terminal. ACA 359. C: ACA 359, buses and passenger steps will be ready in ten minutes.
Question: what did ACA 359 request?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：皮埃尔塔台，ACA 359，空客330，右主起落架两个轮胎爆胎，无法脱离跑道。管制员（C）：收到，ACA 359，我将通知机场，协助即将抵达。飞行员（P）：谢谢。我们请求提供旅客梯和巴士，将乘客送往航站楼。ACA 359。管制员（C）：ACA 359，巴士和旅客梯将在10分钟内准备就绪。问题：ACA 359请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Passenger steps and ferry buses.

cards.audioText:
P: CSN 306 boarding has not completed yet. Besides, we have a catering delay, will be ready in one five minutes. Could you put me on request for a slot time after three zero? C: Roger, CSN 306, your slot time is three five.
Question: which of the following is not the possible reason for delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：CSN 306，登机尚未完成，此外配餐延误，15分钟后准备就绪。能否申请30分钟后的起飞时段？管制员（C）：收到，CSN 306，你的起飞时段为35分钟后。问题：以下哪项不是延误的可能原因？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Broken catering truck.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, SIA895, we missed the outer marker and going around, can you check the outer marker at your end before we make another attempt to land.
C: SIA895, roger, standard procedure.
C: SIA895, the outer marker operation is normal.
Q: What is the pilot's request?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，新航895，我们错过了外指点标，复飞了，在我们再次着陆之前，你可以检查下你那边的外指点标吗？管制员：新航895，收到，标准（复飞）程序。管制员：新航895，外指点标正常工作。问：飞行员的请求是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Examine the outer marker.

cards.audioText:
P: AFR 015, request offset to the right of course to detour the buildup present heading 180C: AFR 015, negative to the right due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees track out 15 miles, to take you well clear of the hazardous weather.
Question: Why was not a right turn allowed?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: AFR 015，请求向航路右侧偏置以绕过积云堆积区，当前航向180。
C: AFR 015，由于右侧有禁区，不同意向右偏置。左转30度，偏航15 miles，使你完全避开危险天气。
问题：为什么不允许向右转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due to forbidden area.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA121, request emergency descent to 8400m. We have just run into severe turbulence.
CTL: CCA121, roger, descend to 8400m. Confirm require any other assistance?
PIL: 5 passengers are injured and aft fuselage is damaged. Request priority landing and medical service on arrival, CCA121.
Q: Which part of the aircraft is damaged?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，国航121，请求紧急下降到8400米，我们飞入严重颠簸中。管：国航121，收到，下降到8400米，需要其它援助吗？飞：有5名乘客受伤，飞机后机身受到损坏。请求优先着陆和到达时医疗服务，国航121。问：飞机哪个部分受到损坏？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The rear.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Hong Kong Approach, CSN3043, port engine failed, will attempt to land at your airport, 5 miles west of Charlie, 8000ft, heading 060.
CTL: CSN3043, Hong Kong Approach, roger Mayday, turn right heading 030, descend to 6000ft, you will be number one, if dangerous goods on board?
PIL: Turn right heading 030, descend to 6000ft, negative dangerous goods, CSN3403.
CTL: Roger, break break, all stations, stop transmitting, Mayday.
Q: Which of the following statement is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday Mayday Mayday，香港进近，南方3043，左发失效，将尝试在你的机场着陆。C西5海里，8000英尺，航向060。管制员：南方3043，香港进近，收到Mayday，右转航向030，下到6000英尺，你是第一个，机上有危险品吗？飞行员：右转航向030，下到6000英尺，没有危险品，南方3403。管制员：收到，断开断开，各台注意，停止发话，有遇险航空器。问：以下哪个说法是正确的？
choices: The aircraft encounters left engine failure.
There is dangerous goods on board.
The aircraft will be descending from 8000ft to 5000ft.
The aircraft is instructed to turn left heading 030.
choicesZh: 飞机将从8000英尺下到5000英尺。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft encounters left engine failure.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday. Wuhan Approach, ACA503, fire detected in rear cabin, dense smoke has spread all over, request emergency assistance, we're maintaining 3,900m on heading 040 degrees, request return to land.
C: ACA503 roger Mayday, turn left heading 210. I will vector you to final of runway 04.
Q: Where is the fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，武汉进近，加航503，客舱后部起火，客舱布满浓烟。请求紧急救援，我们现在保持在高度3900米，航向040，请求返场着陆。管制员：加航503，收到Mayday，左转航向210，我将引导你到跑道04的五边。问：哪里起火了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Rear part of the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, Beijing Tower, backtrack to the stand, we received a call saying that a baggage loader was locked in your cargo hold.
PIL: Roger, turning around, CCA101.
Q: Why did the aircraft have to delay lining up?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航101，北京塔台，原路返回站台，我们收到电话说行李装运人员被锁在货舱内。飞：收到，掉头，国航101。问：为什么飞机要推迟排队？
choices: Because there was traffic on final.
Because a person was locked in the cargo hold.
Because a terrorist was on board.
choicesZh: 因为有人被锁在货舱内。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because a person was locked in the cargo hold.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, BAW141, we have to taxi back to the terminal because our EGT is too high, close to the limit.
C: BAW141, can you manage to taxi under your own power?
P: I'd better shut down the engine and wait for a tug.
C: BAW141, wait there and I will contact a tug driver. A tug will reach you soon.
Q: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：地面，英航141，我们需要滑回航站楼，因为我们发动机的排气温度过高，快接近极限温度了。管制员：英航141，你可以自行滑回吗？飞行员：我最好关闭发动机，然后等拖车来。管制员：英航141，原地等待，我将联系拖车司机，拖车马上就到。问：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The engine temperature is high.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, KLM 546, our fuel endurance is only 50 minutes. We'd like to refuel at Rock.
C: KLM546, you'd better proceed to Mansfield instead, because the ground handling personnel at Rock are on strike. Advise if able.
Question: Why KLM 546 cannot refuel at Rock?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：区调，荷航546，我们的燃油续航只有50分钟。我们想在约克加油。管制员：你最好飞往曼斯菲尔德，因为约克的地面人员现在罢工了，如果可以的话，请告知。问：荷航546为什么不能在约克加油？
choices: Because the refueling personnel are unavailable.
Because they had a bird strike.
Refueling is difficult to handle in Rock.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because the refueling personnel are unavailable.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR121, stand Z4, information F, ready for pushback and startup.
C: AFR121, the tug A blue which was assigned to push back has some malfunction. I am working on sending another tug, standby.
P: Wilco, AFR121.
Q: Why does the controller ask AFR121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：地面，法航121，停机位Z4，通播F，准备好滑出和开车了。管制员：法航121，指派了一辆蓝色拖车，但是这辆拖车除了故障，我正让另一辆拖车过去，稍等。飞行员：照办，法航121。问：为什么管制员让法航121等待？
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Tug has broken down.

cards.audioText:
C: CA1, taxi into position and hold.
P: There is a large flock of birds Runway 14R.
C: CA1, the birds are there all the time.
P: Do you have alternate runway?
C: Runway 27L is available. Expect 15 minutes delay.
P: CA1, we will accept a little delay.
C: CA1, hold at present position, I can't approve it yet, opposite traffic on T.
Question: Which of the statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CA1，进入跑道等待。
P: Runway 14R上有一大群鸟。
C: CA1，那里一直都有鸟。
P: 有其他跑道吗？
C: Runway 27L可用，预计延误15分钟。
P: CA1，我们可以接受短暂延误。
C: CA1，在当前位置等待，我暂时无法批准，滑行道T上有对头航空器。
问题：以下哪项陈述正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The crew requests a different runway.
choices: The birds will be moved out of the way.
The delay is too long, so they accept the clearance.
The crew requests a different runway.
choicesZh: 延误时间太长，因此他们接受该许可。
机组请求使用另一条跑道。

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5525, runway 36, cleared to land, wind calm.
PIL: Runway 36, cleared to land, CES5525.
CTL: CES5525, minimum delay on the runway after landing, no need to acknowledge.
Q: What did CES5525 need to do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：东方5525，跑道36，可以着陆，静风。飞：跑道36，可以着陆，东方5525。管：东方5525，着陆后有点延误，不需要认收。问：东方5525接下来需要怎样做？
choices: Continue approach and readback the instruction.
Continue approach and remain on the runway after landing.
Continue approach without responding the instruction.
choicesZh: 继续进近，着陆后在跑道停留。
继续进近，不需要回应指令。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Continue approach without responding the instruction.

cards.audioText: instructed, CSN 330, Beijing Control, CSN 330, if you copy, squawk ident. CSN 330, Transmitting on 121.5. Question: What is happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 已指示，CSN 330。北京管制，CSN 330，如果收到，设置应答机识别。CSN 330，在121.5上发射。问题：空中交通管制员与飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
A: I was wondering whether you know the wind shear.
B: Yes, the most hazardous wind shear is microburst. It can occur beneath a thunderstorm, rain shower or cumulous cloud.
Q: What kind of wind shear is most dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：我想知道你知道风切变吗？
B：是的，最危险的风切变是微下击暴流，它可以在雷暴、暴雨或者积雨云下方出现。
问：什么样的风切变最危险？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. microburst.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Tower, BAW 70, we have lost steering capability, and we can't vacate the runway on our own.
C: roger, advise your intention.
P: we need a maintenance crew to examine our nose wheel and...a tow back to the terminal, BAW 70.
Question: What happened to BAW 70?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉塔台，BAW 70，我们失去了转向能力，无法自行脱离跑道。
C: 收到，报告你的意图。
P: 我们需要维修人员检查前轮，并需要一辆牵引车将我们拖回航站楼，BAW 70。
问题：BAW 70发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Nose wheel cannot be steered.
choices: Nose wheel had a blown tyre.

cards.audioText:
P: London Control, BAW 403, we lost pitch control. We need a very long final. Request fire service assistance upon landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000ft, heading 250. C: BAW 403, London, continue this heading for the moment. We will position you to a long straight-in approach in a few minutes.
Question: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：伦敦管制，BAW 403，我们失去了俯仰操纵能力，需要一个很长的最后进近。请求着陆时提供消防救援。当前位置距跑道入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。管制员：BAW 403，伦敦管制，暂时保持此航向，几分钟后我们将引导你建立长距离直线进近。问题：飞行员提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A long distance final.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ramp Control, CES256, the catering truck has not arrived, could you check it for me?
CTL: CES256, since there are a lot of diverting aircraft, catering will be slower than usual. Call you back.
Q: According to the statement, what might be the cause of the delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：机坪，东方256，配餐车还没到，能帮我查一下么？管：东方256，由于备降飞机很多，配餐会比平时慢一些。稍等叫你。问：根据叙述，造成延误的可能原因是？
choices: The catering truck got some problem.
The catering workers were on strike.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Too many aircraft needed catering.

cards.audioText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, HK Approach, Cathay 784, 30 miles west of Hong Kong at 8,000 feet, passenger with suspected heart attack, request priority landing. Question: Why does the crew ask for priority landing?
cards.audioTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，香港进近，国泰784，距离香港30海里，高度8000英尺，乘客疑似心脏病发作，请求优先着陆。问：机组为什么请求优先着陆？
choices: A passenger is attacking the crew.
There is a criminal suspect on board.
They are at a too low altitude.
choicesZh: 机上有一名犯罪嫌疑人。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A passenger is seriously ill.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Tower, CCA996, we have found some rubber on the runway, have you heard any reports from other aircraft that has departed from this runway recently.
C: CCA996, negative, you are the first reporter, where exactly you've found the debris?
Q: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：天津塔台，国航996，我们在跑道上发现了一些橡胶碎片，在最近从这条跑道起飞的其他飞机上，你们有没有收到相关报告？管制员：国航996，没有，你是第一个报告的，你是在哪里发现的这些碎片的？问：飞行员报告了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rubber on the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 342, unknown traffic 10 o'clock 6 miles crossing left to right, height unknown, fast moving, if not sight, turn left heading 270. P: turn left heading 270, BAW 342. C: BAW 342, clear of traffic, resume own navigation, direct to LARIX. P: Wilco, BAW 342.
Question: Why did BAW 342 turn left?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 342，不明航空器在你10点钟方向、距离6海里，正从左向右穿越，高度不明，速度很快。如未目视该航空器，左转航向270。飞行员：左转航向270，BAW 342。管制员：BAW 342，已避开冲突航空器，恢复自主领航，直飞LARIX。飞行员：照办，BAW 342。问题：BAW 342为什么左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Danger of collision with another aircraft.
choices: Danger of collision with the ground.
Danger of collision with another aircraft.
choicesZh: 有与另一架航空器相撞的危险。

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 121, Stand Z4, Information F, ready for pushback and startup.
C: AFR 121, the tug A blue for pushback has malfunctioned, I am sending another tug, stand by.
P: Wilco, AFR 121.
Question: Why does the controller ask AFR 121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，AFR 121，Z4停机位，通播F，已准备好推出和启动。
C: AFR 121，用于推出的牵引车发生故障，我正在派另一辆牵引车，稍等。
P: 照办，AFR 121。
问题：管制员为什么要求AFR 121等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tug has broken down.
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CCA4106, ZF-1D, 3,600m, can I expedite climbing to 6,600m? I am a little behind the schedule.
C: CCA4106, negative for the moment due traffic. Climb and maintain 5,400m.
Q: What is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉区调，国航4106，离场程序ZF-1D，高度3600米，我可以加速爬升至6600米吗？我比计划时间有点晚了。管制员：国航4106，目前由于航空器，不可以，爬升到5400米保持。问：飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: He would like to catch up time.
He would climb to 5,400m due the schedule.
He cannot climb to 6,600m due traffic.
choicesZh: 由于计划时间，他想爬升至5400米。
由于航空器，他无法爬升至6600米。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. He would like to catch up time.

cards.audioText:
A: There's a broadcast that provides current routine information to arriving and departing aircraft by means of continuous and repetitive broadcasting throughout the day.
B: And it is identified by ICAO spelling alphabet letters, and transmitted in alphabetical order.
Q: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：有一个广播，通过连续和重复的广播，全天候的向到达和离场的飞机提供常规信息。
B：它由国际民航组织拼写字母识别，并按字母顺序传送。
问：他们正在讨论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ATIS.

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, CCA101, engine fire, on short final, request fire services on arrival.
CTL: Fire services on arrival, roger, CCA101. Do you require an ambulance?
PIL: Affirm. Request emergency evacuation on arrival, CCA101.
Q: What will CCA101 not require on arrival?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，国航101，发动机失火，短五边，请求到达时提供消防服务。管：到达时提供消防服务，收到，国航101。需要救护车么？飞：是的。请求到达时紧急疏散，国航101。问：到达时国航101不需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Emergency separation.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Approach, CCA 981, No. 2 engine flamed out during climbing, we intend to return to land, but we have to dump 20 tons of fuel first.
C: CCA 982, set heading to YV, after passing YV, heading 350, to start dumping, upon completion, turn left heading 160 to YV, maintain 5100m.
Question: What can we learn from this exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京进近，CCA 981，No. 2发动机在爬升过程中熄火，我们打算返航着陆，但必须先放掉20 tons燃油。
C: CCA 982，飞向YV，通过YV后航向350，开始放油；完成后左转航向160返回YV，保持5100m。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. CCA 981's is too heavy to land safely.
choices: CCA 981's is too heavy to land safely.
CCA 981 is coming back due to bird ingestion.
CCA 981 is coming back due engine overheating.
CCA 981 is holding for fuel jettison.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, ACA 503, we lost the ILS signals, and we are going around, 300 meters climbing now, turning to DA.
C: ACA 503, Wuhan approach, roger, climb and maintain 900 meters, report your intention.
P: Roger, climb to 900 meters on QNH, we request to make another approach, ACA 503.
Question: Why did ACA 503 make a missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，ACA 503，我们失去了ILS信号，正在复飞，现正通过300m爬升，转向DA。
C: ACA 503，武汉进近，收到，爬升并保持900m，报告你的意图。
P: 收到，按QNH爬升至900m，我们请求再次进近，ACA 503。
问题：ACA 503为什么复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because they lost ILS signal.
choices: Because they lost radio contact with ATC.
Because they lost visual reference at minima.
Because they lost control of the passengers.
choicesZh: 因为他们与空管失去无线电联系。
因为他们在最低标准处失去目视参考。
因为他们无法控制乘客。

cards.audioText:
CTL: SIA996, taxi via taxiway E4 to holding point runway 36 right.
PIL: E4 to 36 right, SIA996.
CTL: SIA996, stop immediately and hold your position. I say again, stop now. One of the ground personnel just reported that they saw a little boy or something climbing into your main gear wheel well. Stop now.
Q: Why did the controller ask the pilot to stop?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：新航996，通过滑行道E4，在跑道36右外等待点等待。飞行员：E4到36右，新航996。管制员：新航996，马上停下，原地等待，我再说一遍，马上停下，一名地面人员报告称看到一个小男孩还是别的东西爬进了你们的主起落架轮舱。问：为什么管制员让飞行员停下？
choices: Something wrong with the main gear wheel well.
Something wrong with nose gear wheel well.
The aircraft has run over one of the ground personnel.
A boy got into the main landing gear bay.
choicesZh: 主起落架轮舱出问题了。
前起落架轮舱出问题了。
飞机从一名地面人员身上压过去了。
一个男孩进入了飞机主起落架轮舱。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A boy got into the main landing gear bay.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, request VOR/DME position report.
PIL: 25 miles from VYK on the 320 radial, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, traffic 10 o'clock, 25 kilometers southeast bound, A330 3000m maintaining, report traffic in sight.
PIL: Traffic in sight, CCA102.
Q: What was CCA102's current position?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，请求VOR/DME位置报。飞：距离VYK的320°径向线25海里处，国航102。管：国航102，10点方向有活动向东南25千米，A330 3000米保持，活动可见时报告。飞：活动可见，国航102。问：国航102当前的位置在哪里？
choices: 10 miles from VYK on the 320 radial.
25 miles from VYK on the 320 radial.
25 kilometers from VYK on the 330 radial.
25 kilometers from VYK on the 300 radial.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 25 miles from VYK on the 320 radial.

cards.audioText:
PIL: ACA767, request climb to FL360 due to turbulence.
CTL: ACA767, FL360 not available due spacing, can you accept FL380?
PIL: Negative due weight, but we need to change level, a lower level is okay, ACA767.
CTL: ACA767, descend to FL300.
Q: Why could ACA767 not accept FL380?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：加航767，由于颠簸请求上升到高度层360。管：加航767，由于间隔，高度层360不可行，你能接受高度层380吗？飞：由于重量不可以，但是我们需要改变高度，可以更低高度，加航767。管：加航767，下降到高度层300。问：加航767为什么不接受高度层380。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to weight.

cards.audioText:
NW18 is taxing to RW 23R via taxiway T.
P: NW18, holding short RW 16.
C: NW18, cleared to cross RW 16 without delay, traffic 3 miles final
P: NW18, unable to expedite, we are stopped.
C: NW18, hold short of RW 16, taxi clearance cancel.
P: NW18, holding short.
Q: Describe what happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 西北18正在通过滑行道T前往跑道23右。飞行员：西北18，在跑道16外等待。管制员：西北18，立即穿越跑道16，五边3海里有航空器。飞行员：西北18，无法加速，我们停下来了。管制员：西北18，在跑道16外等待，取消滑行许可。飞行员；西北18，在跑道外等待。问：描述下发生了什么？
choices: They didn't accept the clearance to cross.
They were going too fast to stop.
They expedited their taxi across RW 16.
They crossed RW 16 and are holding short of taxiway Tango.
choicesZh: 他们没有接受穿越跑道的许可。
他们速度太快，无法停下。
他们穿越跑道16，并在滑行道T外等待。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They didn't accept the clearance to cross.

cards.audioText:
P: Manchester Ground, UAL 94, we have hydraulic problem, we have lost nose wheel steering, we have to hold position and request send a tug to take us back to the gate.
C: roger, UAL 94, stand by.
C: UAL 94, suggest you shut down the engine, there is a tug for the flight.
P: UAL 94, roger.
Question: What problem does UAL 94 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 曼彻斯特地面，UAL 94，我们有液压问题，已失去前轮转向能力，必须原地等待，请求派一辆牵引车将我们拖回登机口。
C: 收到，UAL 94，稍等。
C: UAL 94，建议关闭发动机，已经为该航班安排了一辆牵引车。
P: UAL 94，收到。
问题：UAL 94有什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A hydraulic problem.
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, BAW 132, 600 meters climbing. C: BAW 132, radar contact, follow LKO-1 departure. Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, expedite climb until passing 1500 meters. Report passing 2100 meters.
Question: what level did ATC clear BAW 132 to climb?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉进近，BAW 132，高度600米，正在爬升。管制员（C）：BAW 132，雷达已识别，沿LKO-1 离场程序飞行。爬升至并保持2700米，在通过1500米前加速爬升。通过2100米时报告。问题：空管批准BAW 132爬升到什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 2700m.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Control, AFR126, over SZ, maintaining 11300m, TZH 01, estimate KM at 45.
CTL: AFR126, direct to KM, HUR then LADIX.
PIL: Roger, direct to KM, then LADIX, AFR126.
CTL: AFR126, direct to KM, HUR then LADIX.
Q: According to the controller, which of the following tracks should AFR126 fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：区调，法航126，飞过SZ，保持11300米，到达TZH时间01分，预计到达KM时间45分。管：法航126，直飞KM，HUR，LADIX。飞：收到，直飞KM，LADIX，法航126。管：法航126，直飞KM，HUR，LADIX。问：根据管制员的话，法航126应按下列哪个航迹飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. KM, HUR, LADIX.

cards.audioText:
C: Speed bird 342, unknown traffic, 10 o' clock, 6 miles, crossing left to right, height unknown, fast moving, if not sighted, turn left heading 270.
P: Left heading 270, speed bird 342.
C: Speed bird 342, clear of traffic, resume own navigation, direct to LADIX
P: Wilco, speed bird 342.
Q: Why did Speed bird 342 turn left?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：英航342，不明航空器，10点方向，6海里，正从左向右穿越，高度不明，移动速度很快，你如果没有看见航空器，左转航向270。飞行员：左转航向270，英航342。管制员：英航342，避开冲突航空器了，恢复自主领航，直飞LADIX。飞行员：照办，英航342。问：英航342为什么左转？
choices: Danger of collision with the ground.
Danger of collision with another aircraft.
choicesZh: 有与其他飞机相撞的危险。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Danger of collision with another aircraft.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW141 continue on the inner, at Mike join the outer, cross 31L at Kilo.
P: Okay by the inner and uh, Mike outer and uh, Kilo Alpha, cross 31L uh, BAW141.
Q: What is the controller's taxi instruction?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：英航141，继续在内滑行道，在M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道。飞行员：好的，内滑行道，在M外滑行道，K，A，穿越跑道，英航141。问：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M.
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K.
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K.
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K.
choicesZh: 在K加入内滑行道，外滑行道，在M穿越跑道31左。
内滑行道，在M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
在M加入外滑行道，内滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
在M加入内滑行道，外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Going around. Confirm there is any standing water before landing at this weight, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, roger, climb to 2100m, contact Departure 126.6.
PIL: Climb to 2100m, 126.6, CCA121.
Q: What's the reason for the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：复飞，以当前重量着陆前确认是否有积水，国航121。管：国航121，收到，上升到2100米，联系离场126.6。飞：上升到2100米，126.6，国航121。问：飞机为什么复飞？
choices: The pilot was unsure of the runway condition.
choicesZh: 飞行员不确定跑道状况。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The pilot was unsure of the runway condition.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Approach, CSN332. Request return to Guangzhou airport. We are unable to deploy our speed brake, possible structural damage.
CTL: CSN332, roger. Turn left, direct to YKI. Further track shortening and runway will advise shortly.
Q: What problem did CSN332 have?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：广州进近，南航332。请求返回广州机场。我们无法减速刹车，可能操作故障。管：南航332，收到。左转直飞YKI。进一步缩短航迹，一会儿通知你跑道。问：南航332遇到了什么问题？
choices: There was something wrong with speed brake.
They couldn't land on the long runway.
choicesZh: 他们不能在长跑道上降落。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There was something wrong with speed brake.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA101, can we take the second right?
C: CCA101 negative backtrack to exit the runway at first left fast turn-off. There are workmen on the second right.
Q: Why did CCA101 have to backtrack?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，国航101，我们可以使用第二个右转滑行道吗？管制员：国航101，不可以，调头，在第一个左转滑行道快速转弯，第二个右转滑行道上有工人。问：为什么国航101要调头？
choices: The pilot on the first left.
A vehicle on the second right.
choicesZh: 第二个右转滑行道上有工人。
第一个左转航行道上有飞行员。
第二个右转滑行道上有汽车。
第一个左转滑行道上有工人。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Workmen on the second right.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, climb to 11600m.
PIL: Unable CCA121. That's too high for us. Request climb to 11300m.
CTL: CCA121, negative, only even levels available. Maintain 10100m or change request.
Q: What was the controller's intention?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航121，上11600米。飞：不能，国航121。太高了。请求上11300米。管：国航121，不行，只有偶数高度可用。保持10100米或更换请求。问：管制员说的是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 10400 meters and 11000 meters were available.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, are you still experiencing any turbulence?
PIL: Only occasional light chop, the storm is behind us now, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, an aircraft crossing 10 miles ahead of you on FL250 reports no significant chop, you should be clear of turbulence soon.
PIL: Roger, CCA121.
Q: What did the controller advise CCA121?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航121，你还在颠簸吗？飞：偶尔有轻度颠簸，风暴现在在我们后方，国航121。管：国航121，你前方10海里高度层250有飞机报告无明显颠簸，不久你可以平稳飞行。飞：收到，国航121。问：管制员告知国航121哪种情况？
choices: They would experience turbulence 10 miles ahead.
They would experience a storm on FL250.
They would experience smoother conditions soon.
They would clear of the other aircraft.
choicesZh: 飞机将在前方10海里遭遇颠簸。
飞机将在高度层250遭遇风暴。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They would experience smoother conditions soon.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN3308, I have to go back to the apron and I need medical assistance upon my arrival. The flight attendant reported that a woman on board has miscarried and needs a doctor.
C: CSN3308, right turn ahead at intersection E5. I will inform those concerned.
Q: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：地面，南方3308，我需要返回停机坪，同时在到达后需要医疗援助。乘务员报告称机上有名女士流产了，需要医生。管制员：南方3308，在前方E5交叉口右转，我将通知相关人员。问：飞机上发生了什么？
choices: A flight attendant was going to give birth to a child.
A pregnant woman was in danger.
A flight attendant reported something wrong with undercarriage.
choicesZh: 一名乘务员要生孩子了。
乘务员报告飞机起落架出问题。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. A pregnant woman was in danger.

cards.audioText:
C: United 985 be advised runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach to runway 16 circle land on runway 23R, surface wind 250 at 5, gusting 15, ceiling 350m broken.
P: United985, information copied, checking our minimum for approach, will advise.
Q: Why can't they approach R/W 23L directly?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：美联航985，告知跑道23左的ILS系统故障，预计VOR进近，跑道16，盘旋着陆，跑道23右，地面风向250，5米，阵风15米，云底高350米，散云。飞行员：美联航985，收到消息，检查我们进近的最低高度，稍后告知。问：他们为什么无法直接进近跑道23左？
choices: Runway 23L ILS is out of service.
choicesZh: 跑道23左的I盲降系统故障。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 23L ILS is out of service.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, UAL897, POLHO 42, 10700m maintaining, squawk 0026, request 11300m.
CTL: UAL897, Beijing, radar contact, can you accept 11900m? If unable, descend to 10100m.
Q: Which levels are available for UAL897?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，美联航897，到达POLHO时间为42分，保持10700米，应答机0026，请求11300米。管：美联航897，北京，雷达已识别，能否接受11900米？如不能，下降10100米。问：美联航897可以在哪一高度飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 11900 meters or 10100 meters.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, standby for pushback, expect delay due congestion on the taxiway.
PIL: Roger. Can you advise how long the delay will be, CCA101?
CTL: CCA101, expect approximately a 5 to 10 minutes delay, there's an unserviceable aircraft shut down on taxiway A requiring tow back to the terminal.
Q: Why was there congestion on the taxiway?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航101，等待推出，由于滑行道拥挤预计延误。飞：收到，预计延误多久，国航101？管：国航101，预计延误5到10分钟，有故障飞机在滑行道A停下并请求拖回航站楼。问：滑行道为什么会出现拥挤情况？
choices: Too many aircraft were on the taxiway.
There was no available tow truck.
An aircraft was stuck on the taxiway.
choicesZh: 一架飞机被卡在滑行道上。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. An aircraft was stuck on the taxiway.

cards.audioText:
P: Qantas 235, holding on taxiway A
C: Qantas 235, hold short for the departure. You are No.2 after the airbus 320.
P: Holding short, No.2 for departure, Qantas 235.
C: Qantas 235, line up and wait.
P: Lining up, Qantas 235.
Q: What was the departure sequence for Qantas 235?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：澳航235，在滑行道A等待。管制员：澳航235，在跑道外等待起飞，在空客320后，你是第二个。飞行员：跑道外等待，第二个起飞，澳航235。管制员：澳航235，上跑道等待。飞行员：上跑道，澳航235。问：澳航235的起飞顺序是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, AFR2256, No.2 engine flame out during climb, request return to Beijing airport.
CTL: AFR2256, Beijing roger, do you require radar vector?
PIL: Affirm, AFR2256.
CTL: AFR2256, radar vector to ILS approach runway 01, emergency assistance has been activated.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京进近，法航2256，爬升时2号发动机熄火，请求返回北京机场。管：法航2256，北京收到，需要雷达引导吗？飞：是的，法航2256。管：法航2256，雷达引导跑道01盲降进近，已准备好紧急援助。问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The aircraft was vectored to runway 01.
choicesZh: 飞机爬升时发动机起火。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft was vectored to runway 01.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, report sighting traffic on your 11 o'clock below.
PIL: Looking, CCA121.
PIL: Negative contact, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, a 747 on your 12 o'clock below, now ahead of you on final for runway 18L, report in sight.
PIL: Still negative contact, advise, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, standby.
Q: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航121，在你下方11点方向的活动可见时报告。飞：正在观察，国航121。飞：无法看到，国航121。管：国航121，一架747在你下方12点方向，现在在你前方18左五边上，能见报。飞：仍然无法看到，请通知，国航121。管：国航121，稍等。问：飞行员报告的是什么情况？
choices: He could not see the 747 and wanted to climb.
He could see the 747 and wanted to know what to do.
He could not see the 747 and wanted to know what to do.
He could see the 747 and was talking to the pilot.
choicesZh: 他能看到747并想知道该怎样做。
他看不到747并想知道该怎样做。
他能看到747并正在和747的飞行员对话。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. He could not see the 747 and wanted to know what to do.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, CSN5402, severe vibration on the left side, we heard a loud explosion, seems we are in big trouble.
C: CSN5402, roger Mayday. What is your intention?
P: We are sorting out the problem, I will call you back.
C: CSN5402, Roger.
Q: What does the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，南方5402，左侧剧烈震动，我们听到了巨大的爆炸声，看起来我们遇到麻烦了。管制员：南方5402，收到Mayday，你的意图是什么？飞行员：我们正在找出问题所在，等下叫你。问：飞行员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To identify the problem.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA4326, after departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m, then follow flight planed route.
P: After departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m then follow flight planed route, CCA4326.
C: CCA4326, line up and wait runway 02, vehicle crossing upwind into the runway.
Q: Where is the vehicle?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：国航4326，起飞后，直线爬升至1200米，然后按计划航路飞行。飞行员：起飞后，直线爬升至1200米，然后按计划航路飞行，国航4326管制员：国航4326，上跑道等待，跑道02，一辆汽车正从离场边穿过跑道。问：汽车在哪？
choices: At the opposite end of the runway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. At the opposite end of the runway.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Departure, CES321, passing 1800m, climbing to 5100m. Request climbing to 5400m.
CTL: CES321, initially climb to 5100m, report passing 2400m.
PIL: Climb to 5100m, wilco, CES321.
Q: What should CES321 do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：离场，东方321，过1800米，爬升5100米。请求爬升5400米。管：东方321，起始爬升5100米，过2400米报告。飞：爬升5100米，东方321照办。问：东方321接下来要做什么？
choices: Climb to 5400 meters and request clearance for 2400 meters.
Tell ATC when reaching and maintaining 2400 meters.
Climb to 5100 meters and report when climbing through 2400 meters.
Climb to 5100 meters and report before reaching 2400 meters.
choicesZh: 爬升到5100米，到达2400米之前叫。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Climb to 5100 meters and report when climbing through 2400 meters.

cards.audioText:
P: B Ground, DAL 153, request departure information.
C: DAL 153, runway in use for takeoff 18L, wind 260, 10 knots, gusting to 20 knots temperature 10, dew point 9, QNH1012 taxiway W between C and D partially closed due work in progress.
Question: Why is the taxiway partially closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: B地面，DAL 153，请求离场情报。
C: DAL 153，起飞使用Runway 18L，风向260度、风速10 knots、阵风20 knots，气温10度、露点9度，QNH 1012。由于正在施工，滑行道W在C和D之间部分关闭。
问题：为什么该滑行道部分关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due work in progress.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES215, divert immediately to Wuhan. We have just received an anonymous call saying there's a bomb on board.
PIL: Wilco, CES215, we'll execute emergency evacuation after landing. Confirm you'll have the bomb disposal squad ready?
Q: Which of the following should the pilot do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：东方215，立刻备降武汉。我们收到匿名电话说飞机上有炸弹。飞：照办，东方215，我们会在着陆后执行紧急撤离。证实拆弹人员已就位？问：飞行员下一步应该怎么做？
choices: Send the bomb disposal squad on board.
Request an anonymous call for the bomb.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Contact Wuhan Approach.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Sierra Approach, BAW 983, emergency descent from FL310 to FL120 due sudden and rapid depressurization, heading 190, approaching SEG.
C: BAW 983, roger Mayday. Squawk 7700, report reaching FL120. No traffic in your area.
Question: For what reason did the crew declare a distress call?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，Sierra进近，BAW 983，因突然且快速失压，正从FL310紧急下降至FL120，航向190，正在接近SEG。
C: BAW 983，收到MAYDAY。应答机7700，到达FL120时报告。你所在区域没有其他航空器。
问题：机组因为什么原因发出遇险呼叫？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Sudden depressurization.

cards.audioText:
A: Captain, do you think that maintenance check is one of the most important pre-flight activities?
B: Oh, yes, it is, it ensures that the airplane condition is acceptable for flight,
A: Em, I agree with you, and the aircraft maintenance engineers should be licensed by aviation authorities to check airframe, engines and system.
Q: What should maintenance engineers do from this conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：机长，你认为维修检查是起飞前最重要的活动之一吗？
B：是的，它可以保证飞机处于适航状态。
A：嗯，我同意你的看法，维修机务人员应当由民航当局授予执照，来检查飞机的机身，发动机和系统。
问：在这段谈话中，维修机务人员应该做什么？
choices: Release the engine, airframe, and systems.
Replace the engine, airframe, and systems.
Consult the engine, airframe, and systems.
Inspect the engine, airframe, and systems.
choicesZh: 释放发动机，机身和系统。
更换发动机，机身和系统。
查阅发动机，机身和系统。
检查发动机，机身和系统。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Inspect the engine, airframe, and systems.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 898, cleared to Beijing via A1 and 6000m, WEKING-4 departure, squawk 5501, eh, correction, standby squawk.
Question: What transponder code should NWA 898 set?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 898，许可经A1、6000m和WeKing 4离场飞往北京，应答机5501，呃，更正，等待应答机代码。
问题：NWA 898应设置什么应答机代码？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Squawk not available yet.

cards.audioText:
P: SWA 346, we have lost all electrical power, except the emergency circuit. Request to divert immediately to Newbridge. C: SWA 346, Roger, turn left heading zero three zero, descend to flight level one five zero. P: Left turn zero three zero, flight level one five zero, SWA 346.
Question: what is the crew going to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：SWA 346，我们失去了所有电力，仅应急电路正常。请求立即备降新桥机场。管制员（C）：SWA 346，收到，左转航向030，下降至150飞行高度层。飞行员（P）：左转030，飞行高度层150，SWA 346。问题：机组人员将要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To land as soon as possible.
choices: To land as soon as possible.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, CCA101, approaching taxiway 23.
CTL: CCA101, good evening, taxi to runway 07L via runway 07R, back track 07R to taxiway 11.
PIL: Confirm taxi straight ahead CCA101.
CTL: CCA101, negative, turn left, back track runway 07R to taxiway 11.
Q: How are they going to get to taxiway 11?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，国航101，到达滑行道23。管制员：国航101，晚上好，通过跑道07右到跑道07左，在跑道07右调头进滑行道11。飞行员：确认直线滑行，国航101。管制员：不可，左转，在跑道07右调头然后进滑行道11。问：他们如何到滑行道11？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. back track on R/W 07R.

cards.audioText:
NWA18 is taxiing to runway 16 via taxiway T.
PIL: NWA18, holding short runway 16.
CTL: NWA18, approved to cross runway 16 without delay, traffic 3 miles final.
PIL: NWA18, unable to expedite, we are stopped.
CTL: NWA18, hold short of taxiway T, taxi clearance cancel.
Q: Describe what happened.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北18正通过滑行道T滑到跑道16。飞：美西北18，跑道16等待。管：美西北18，同意立刻穿过跑道16，五边3海里有活动。飞：美西北18，无法加速，飞机已停下。管：美西北18，滑行道T等待，取消滑行许可。问：请描述发生了什么情况。
choices: They didn't accept the clearance to cross.
They were going too fast to stop.
They crossed 16 and are holding short of taxiway T.
choicesZh: 飞机没有接收许可进行穿行。
飞机速度过快无法停下。
飞机加速滑行穿过跑道16。
飞机穿过跑道16，正在滑行道T等待。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They didn't accept the clearance to cross.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1365, Beijing Control, climb to and maintain 11000m. P: Request cruising level 9800m. Forecast weather is more favorable at this level, CCA 1365. C: Roger, CCA 1365, climb to and maintain 9800m, final level.
Question: Why has CCA 1365 requested a lower level?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：CCA 1365，北京管制，爬升并保持11000米。飞行员：请求巡航高度9800米，预报显示该高度的天气更有利，CCA 1365。管制员：收到，CCA 1365，爬升并保持9800米，作为最终高度。问题：CCA 1365为什么请求较低的高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To save fuel or time.

cards.audioText:
A: Take the next right.
B: Are you sure? This is the runway, we must miss the turn, tell Ground holding for instructions.
C: CCA001 is just about to call you, you missed T, you may proceed down 5L, it's not active, turn left on E, turn right on S to the runway, try not to miss S or you'll beyond the runway.
Q: What did the crew do wrong?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：下个口右转。
B：你确定吗？这是跑道，我们肯定错过转弯了，告诉地面，原地等待下一步指令。
C：国航001，正打算呼叫你，你们错过了滑行道T，你们可以继续滑行到跑道05左，此跑道为非活动跑道，在E左转，在S右转进跑道，尽量别错过S，否则你们就出跑道了。
问：机组做错了什么？
choices: They are now on taxiway Echo.
They missed the turn onto Tango.
choicesZh: 他们在滑行道T错过转弯。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They missed the turn onto Tango.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CSN309, what are the delays like? We've been holding for over 30mins.
CTL: CSN309, Beijing Control. Still waiting for military clearance.
PIL: If clearance not available, request radar vector to deviate military airspace, CSN309.
CTL: CSN309, now cleared, turn right direct to WXI.
Q: What did the crew want to do to avoid further delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，南航309，延误怎么样了？我们已经等了30多分钟了。管：南航309，北京区调。继续等待空军放行。飞：如果不能放行，请求雷达引导偏离军事活动空域，南航309。管：南航309，活动清除，右转直飞WXI。问：为了避免延迟更久，飞行员想做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Circumnavigate the military airspace.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday Mayday Mayday, JAL610, we've just been hit by a light aircraft, left wing-tip appears to have been torn off. It seems to be undertaking an emergency descent. We'll try to land at Qingdao.
Q: What did the pilot encounter?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday Mayday Mayday，日航610，我们与一架轻型飞机相撞，我们左翼尖看起来已脱落，它们看起来正在执行紧急下降。我们将尽力在青岛着陆。问：飞行员遇到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Mid-air collision.

cards.audioText:
P: Chengdu Tower, good morning, SIA952, established on the ILS.
C: SIA952, good morning, continue ILS approach, runway 02.
P: Continue SIA952.
C: SIA952, we have a report that a dog on the runway so advise caution during your approach, you may get a late clearance.
Q: Why did Control advise caution to SIA952?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：成都塔台，早上好，新航952，已建立盲降。管制员：新航952，早上好，继续盲降进近，跑道02。飞行员：继续进近，新航952。管制员：新加坡952，我们收到报告，跑道上有一条狗，进近时小心，晚点给你许可。问：管制员为什么建议新航952小心点？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Animal on the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: SAS996, for identification, turn left heading 270, then turn right 360.
P: roger, left 270, then right 360, SAS996.
Question: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: SAS 996，为便于识别，左转航向270，然后右转航向360。
P: 收到，左转270，然后右转360，SAS 996。
问题：正在进行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The controller is trying to find the aircraft on radar.
choices: The controller is trying to find the aircraft on radar.
The pilot is trying to find the aircraft on radar.
choicesZh: 管制员正在雷达上搜寻该飞机。
飞行员正在雷达上搜寻该飞机。

cards.audioText:
P: NWA 968, waiting at holding point 29, request return to the stand, the brakes are overheating.
C: roger, NWA 968, return to the holding bay, first convenient turn left onto taxiway J.
P: left turn onto Taxiway J, NWA 968.
Question: Which taxiway is NWA 968 to use?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: NWA 968，在29等待点等待，请求返回停机位，刹车过热。
C: 收到，NWA 968，返回等待坪，在第一个方便的路口左转进入滑行道J。
P: 左转进入滑行道J，NWA 968。
问题：NWA 968将使用哪条滑行道？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Taxiway J.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA918, hold at holding point D, give way to A320 passing left to right.
PIL: Holding at D, CCA918.
PIL: Ground, CCA918, traffic is cleared, request continue taxi.
CTL: CCA918, cross D, then taxi via C and J to holding point runway 26.
Q: How should CCA918 taxi to holding point runway 26?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航918，在等待点D等待，给从左向右通过的A320让路。飞：在D点等待，国航918。飞：地面，国航918，飞机已通过，请求继续滑行。管：国航918，穿过D，然后经C和J滑到跑道26等待点。问：国航918应该如何滑到跑道26等待点？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Via C and J.

cards.audioText:
A: There are different types and degrees of pre-flight inspection.
B: Ah, yes, the individual components will be replaced based on the number of landings, flying hours, and other criteria.
Q: What are the criteria for replacement of individual item?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：有不同类型和等级的航前检查。
B：是的，个别组件会根据着陆次数、飞行时间和其他标准进行更换。
问：更换个别组件的标准是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number of landings.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA177, we have been experiencing severe turbulence at this flight level. Could we have a slightly low level?
C: ACA177, standby.
P: Roger, ACA177, if not available, we also accept a higher level.
C: ACA177, fly to FL370.
Q: Why does the pilot want to change the flight level?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：加航177，我们在此高度层经历了严重颠簸，我们可以下降点高度吗？管制员：加航177，稍等。飞行员：加航177，如果低高度不可用，我们也可以接受高一点的高度。管制员：加航177，上高度层370。问：飞行员为什么想要改变高度层？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Present level is too turbulent.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, request go round the CB from the right.
C: CCA 101, negative due to prohibited area (=forbidden area). Turn left 40 degrees track out 30km, report clear of CB.
Question: Why was CCA 101 not allowed to turn to left?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉管制，请求从右侧绕飞CB。
C: CCA 101，由于有禁区，不同意。左转40度，偏航30km，避开CB后报告。
问题：为什么不允许CCA 101向左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL655, we have a serious fuel leak, we are returning.
C: UAL655, descend to 3300m.
P: Leaving 5400m for 3300m, UAL655.
C: UAL655, do you require emergency assistance on landing?
P: Affirm, UAL655.
Q: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：美联航655，飞机出现严重燃油泄漏，我们正在返航。管制员：美联航655，下降到3300米。飞行员：离开5400米到3300米，美联航655。管制员：美联航655，你需要在落地后请求紧急援助吗？飞行员：是的，美联航655。问：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fuel leak.

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL15, be advised runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach to runway 16 circle to land runway 23R, surface wind 250 at 5, gusting to 15. Ceiling 350 meters, broken.
PIL: UAL15, information copied, checking our minima for approach, will advised.
Q: Which active runway is the surface wind favoring?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：美联航15，跑道23左盲降失效，预计VOR进近跑道16，盘旋着陆跑道23右。地面风风向250风速5节，云底高350米，多云。飞：美联航15，消息已收到，检查进近最低标准。问：地面风对哪条现用跑道有利？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 23R.

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 785, the ground mechanics reported that two white navigational light and one stroke light below APU exhaust off.
P: is that so, we have to check the MEL.
P: Ground, JAL 785, it's not airworthy, we will taxi back to park for replacement.
Question: Why did the aircraft taxi back?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 785，地面机务人员报告，APU排气口下方的两盏白色航行灯和一盏频闪灯熄灭。
P: 是吗？我们必须检查MEL。
P: 地面，JAL 785，该航空器不适航，我们将滑行返回停机位更换故障灯。
问题：航空器为什么滑行返回？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Not within MEL requirements.
choices: Not in an air operating condition.
choicesZh: 不符合最低设备清单要求。

cards.audioText:
A: Did you hear of the accident that occurred recently in France?
B: No, what about it?
A: The air crash of a helicopter caused a local forest fire but fortunately it was extinguished quickly. The air crash resulted in a loss of three lives.
Q: What were the consequences of the air crash?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你听说最近发生在法国的事故了吗？
B：没有，发生了什么事？
A：一架直升机失事，引起当地森林火灾，幸运的是，大火很快被扑灭，但是此次失事造成了3人死亡。
问：飞机失事的后果是什么？
choices: It resulted in the loss of three lives.
choicesZh: 森林火灾，但很快被扑灭。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Death and forest fire.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Tower, please tell AFR805 they'll have to report to health service on landing, they may expect a quarantine, cause we're very tight on validity dates of the health certificates at the moment.
Q: What will AFR805 do according to what is said above?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：广州塔台，告知法航805，他们着陆后必须要向健康部门报告。他们可能会被隔离，因为我们现在对于健康资质有效期政策很严格。问：根据以上所说，法航805要做什么？
choices: They should lengthen their validity date.
choicesZh: 他们应该提供健康服务。
他们应该加长有效日期。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They may experience a quarantine.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Control, CSN4971, we are unable to control pressurization, cabin altitude is rising fast, request immediate descent, 3000m.
C: CSN4971, descend 3000m, report reaching.
P: Descending, 3000m. Report reaching, CSN4971.
Q: What was the crew's initial maneuver?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：天津区调，南方4971，我们无法控制增压系统，客舱高度正迅速上升，请求立刻下降到3000米。管制员：南方4971，下降到3000米，到达后报。飞行员：下降到3000米，到达后报，南方4971。问：机组的初始操纵是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Go to lower altitude.

cards.audioText:
P: Rock Approach, Trans 351, we won't be able to dump. We've got an engine on fire at this time and we'll have to come back and land with the fuel on board.
C: Roger 351, make a right turn, I say again a right turn on to heading 350.
Question: What is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：约克进近，Trans351，我们无法放油。目前我们有一个发动机起火，我们将必须返航，并带燃油着陆。管制员：收到351，右转，我再说一遍，右转航向350。问：飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: To come back after dumping fuel.
To get an engine on fire.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To return for landing.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CSN3251, request taxi.
CTL: CSN3251, for information, UAL236 and CCA901, both B747s nearly collided on runway 14R 1 minute ago, stay there, I'll call you back.
PIL: Roger, holding, CSN3251.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：地面，南航3251，请求滑行。管：南航3251，提示，美联航236和国航901，两架波音747，1分钟前险些在跑道14右相撞。原地等待，稍后呼叫你。飞：收到，等待，南航3251。问：发生了什么情况？
choices: There was a crash on the runway.
There was almost a collision on the runway.
There was a vehicle on the runway.
choicesZh: 跑道上差点发生了相撞。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was almost a collision on the runway.

cards.audioText:
A: I've been told there are some changes for my departure.
B: Yes, the changes are as follows, climb on runway heading until 6000ft, then turn right to intercept 235 radial of MT VOR
Q: Which radio must be intercepted?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：我被告知离场信息有一些变化。
B：是的，做了一下变化，沿跑道方向爬升到6000英尺，然后右转至截获MT VOR台235径向线。
问：必须截获的无线电台是哪个？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 235 radial of MT VOR.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 201, you are taking the wrong direction, taxiway F is closed due to emergency traffic. Turn left to taxiway D and A to the holding point of Runway 09.
P: Turn left to taxiway D and A to the holding point of Runway 09, UAL 201.
Question: Why was taxiway F closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 201，你的滑行方向错误，F滑行道因紧急航空器而关闭。左转，经D和A滑行道滑行至Runway 09等待点。
P: 左转，经D和A滑行道滑行至Runway 09等待点，UAL 201。
问题：F滑行道为什么关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An emergency traffic had not vacated the taxiway F.
choices: Its lighting system was out of service.
A broken traffic had skidded off the runway.
An emergency traffic had not vacated the taxiway F.
An emergency traffic took the wrong direction.
choicesZh: 一辆故障车辆滑出跑道。
一架紧急航空器尚未脱离F滑行道。
一架紧急航空器走错了方向。

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CCA4016, we are ready to join R343.
C: CCA4016, join R343 over KG at 4800m before 35.
P: Roger, I will join R343 as instructed, CCA4016.
Q: What items are contained in the control's instructions?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉区调，国航4016，我们已经准备好加入R343航路。管制员：国航4016，过KG点，高度4800米，在35分之前加入R343航路。飞行员：收到，我将按指令加入R343航路，国航4016。问：管制员的指令中包含了哪些项目？
choicesZh: 空中航线，航路点，应答机编码。
航路点，时间，高度层，空中航线。
航路点，时间，高度层，空中航线，速度。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Waypoint, time, level, airway.

cards.audioText: Panpan, panpan, panpan, New York Tower, BAW 452, we have an engine fire warning light. We have completed emergency checklist procedure, warning light remains illuminated. However, there is no visible signs of fire. We will need to vacate the runway, request taxi instructions. Question: What action did the crew take?
cards.audioTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，纽约塔台，BAW 452，我们的发动机火警灯亮起。我们已完成紧急检查单程序，但警告灯仍然亮着。不过，没有可见的起火迹象。我们需要脱离跑道，请求滑行指令。问题：机组采取了什么行动？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They did the emergency checklist.
choices: They shut down the faulty engine.
They extinguished the fire on engine.
choicesZh: 他们执行了紧急检查单。
他们关闭了故障发动机。
他们扑灭了发动机火灾。

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN326 confirm squawking 7500?
PIL: Affirm, CSN326. We have to go to Hong Kong airport but there's not enough fuel, we must divert to Zhengzhou airport for that.
Q: What should CSN326 do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航326，确认应答机7500？飞：是的，南航326。我们要飞往香港机场，但飞机没有足够燃油，我们必须备降郑州机场。问：南航326下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Divert to Hong Kong airport due to hijack.
Change its final destination to Zhengzhou airport.
choicesZh: 由于劫机，备降香港机场。
将目的地改为郑州机场。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Refuel at Zhengzhou airport.

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, CES5402, we heard a loud explosion, severe vibration on the left side, we might be in some trouble here.
CTL: CES5402, roger MAYDAY. Advise intentions.
PIL: Standby. We're sorting out what is going on, CES5402.
CTL: CES5402, roger.
Q: What did the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，东方5402，我们听到巨大的爆炸声，左侧剧烈震动，我们可能遇到麻烦了。管：东方5402，收到MAYDAY。请示意图。飞：稍等，我们正在检查原因，东方5402。管：东方5402，收到。问：飞行员想做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Identify the problem.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN141, taxi to the holding point runway 36 for a taxiway A4 and A. Taxi with caution, taxiway is slippery.
CTL: CSN141, stop immediately, there is conflicting traffic on the way to you.
PIL: Stopping, traffic in sight, CSN141.
Q: What did the flight crew possibly see on their way?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航141，经滑行道A4和A滑到跑道36等待点。滑行时注意，滑行道很滑。管：南航141，立刻停止，途中有接近的冲突活动。飞：已经停下，活动可见，南航141。问：机组在滑行途中可能看到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Oncoming traffic.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Jinan Control, CCA1037, all compass read 180 now. There must have been a short power failure, probably very short, because the warning flags didn't even come on.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：济南区调，国航1037，所有指南者读数180度，肯定是出现了短时间的断电，可能很短，因为告警旗都没有出现。问：发生了什么？
choices: The compass are out of service.
There is a power short circuit.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a power failure.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Tower, CCA 996, we've found some rubber on the runway, have you had any reports that aircraft has just departed from the runway recently?
C: CCA 996, negative, you are the first report.
Question: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 天津塔台，CCA 996，我们发现跑道上有一些橡胶。你们是否收到过刚有航空器从该跑道离场的报告？
C: CCA 996，没有，你是第一个报告。
问题：飞行员报告了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rubber on the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 123, Wuhan ground, take off and landing Runway 18L, wind 150 degrees at 8 meters per second, QNH 1005 P: Runway 18R, QNH 1005, AFR 123. C: AFR 123, negative, runway in use, 18 left.
Question: what mistake did the pilot make?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员（C）：AFR 123，武汉地面，起飞和着陆跑道为18左，风向150度，风速8米/秒，修正海压1005。飞行员（P）：跑道18右，修正海压1005，AFR 123。管制员（C）：AFR 123，错误，使用中跑道为18左。问题：飞行员犯了什么错误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Wrong copy of runway.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Approach, ACA626, what is the delay like?
CTL: ACA626, delay uncertain, snow is picking up, say intention.
PIL: Approach, ACA626, standby, we'll contact our dispatcher, call you back.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the cause of the delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：进近，加航626，延误情况如何？管：加航626，延误时间不确定，雪越来越大，说明意图。飞：进近，加航626，稍等，我们会联系签派，稍后呼叫你。问：根据对话，延误的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Snow was getting heavier.

cards.audioText:
P: Sydney control, CCA 101, flight level nine zero, heading zero three five, descending to flight level six zero. C: CCA 101, hold on the three four five radio of the HUR VOR at one zero DME, Maintain 3000 meters, inbound track 165 degrees, right hand pattern, expected approach time 8. P: Hold on the 345 radio of the HUR VOR at 10 DME, maintain 3000 meters, inbound track 165 degrees, right hand pattern, expected approach Time eight, CCA 101.
Question: what is the inbound track?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：悉尼空管，CCA 101，飞行高度层90，航向035，下降至飞行高度层60。管制员（C）：CCA 101，在HUR VOR的345度无线电方位线、10海里处等待，保持3000米，向台航迹165度，右等待航线，预计进近时间8点。飞行员（P）：确认在HUR导航台345度方位线10海里处等待，保持3000米，向台航迹165度，右等待航线，预计进近时间8点，CCA 101。问题：向台航迹（inbound track）是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 165 degrees.

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL785, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
PIL: Approach, we prefer a visual approach to runway 36L, this will save time, UAL785.
CTL: Negative, the visibility is too low, you have to make a precision approach, the glide path of runway 36L is inoperative.
Q: What did UAL785 request?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：美联航785，使用36右盲降进近。飞：进近，我们希望跑道36左目视进近，可以节省时间，美联航785。管：不同意，可见度太低，必须精密进近，跑道36左下滑道不可用。问：美联航785请求的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Visual approach runway 36L.

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CCA102, bird strike, aircraft under control, but No.1 engine flame out after bird ingestion, require landing but request dump fuel for 8mins first.
CTL: Roger PAN, CCA102. Proceed to YV at 4200m, after passing YV, heading 350 for dumping.
Q: What caused the engine problem?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉进近，国航102，鸟击，飞机可控，但由于吸鸟，1号发动机熄火，需要降落，但请求先放油8分钟。管：收到PAN，国航102，直飞YV，高度4200米，飞过YV后，航向350放油。问：造成发动机故障的原因是什么？
choices: The aircraft was struck by unidentified objects.
The captain could not control the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The aircraft suffered bird ingestion.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN2256, Wuhan Tower, we have confirmed your hydraulic problem, say intention.
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CSN2256, we have manually lowered the gear, but gear unsafe indication on, request low pass for a visual inspection.
Q: After confirmation of the hydraulic problem, what did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航2256，武汉塔台，我们已被告知飞机液压故障，说明意图。飞：武汉塔台，南航2256，已经手动放下起落架，但起落架危险指示仍在，请求低空通场进行目视检查。问：确认液压故障后，飞行员报告哪种情况？
choices: They had put the undercarriage down safely.
They could not put the undercarriage down.
They wanted to check whether the undercarriage was safe.
They had put the undercarriage down automatically.
choicesZh: 飞行员想检查起落架是否安全。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They wanted to check whether the undercarriage was safe.

cards.audioText:
P: CCA101, we are now 4800 meters, passing WZF, information E received.
C: CCA101, radar contact, descend to 3000 meters, turn right heading 040, radar vectoring ILS approach runway 36R.
Q: What are the controller's instructions on new altitude, flight heading, and runway in use?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：国航101，目前高度4800米，通过WZF，收到通播E。管制员：国航101，雷达识别，下降到3000米，右转航向040，雷达引导ILS进近，跑道36右。问：管制员新指令中的新高度，航向，使用跑道是什么？

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Beijing Approach, AFR261, 30 miles east of KM at 6300m, epidemic on board, request priority landing and quarantine measures.
CTL: Roger PAN, AFR261, priority landing approved, we'll report to organize evacuation.
Q: According to the passage, why evacuation should be taken?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，北京进近，法航261，KM以东30海里，6300米，飞机上有传染病人，请求优先降落并实施检疫措施。管：收到PAN，法航261，可以优先降落，我们将报告并组织援救。问：根据对话，为什么要实施援救？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was pandemic on board.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CCA102 estimating VW 32, descending to 3600m.
CTL: CCA102, Wuhan, hold at VW as published, expect further clearance at 49, landing delays due to military activity.
Q: According to the statement, how long would the aircraft be delayed?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：武汉区调，国航102，预计到达VW时间为32分，下降至3600米。管：国航102，武汉，在VW标准等待，由于空军活动，预计等待时间为49分。问：根据叙述，飞机要延误多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 17 minutes.

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA314, behind B737 on short final, line up behind, runway 25.
PIL: Behind B737, line up runway 25, ACA314.
CTL: ACA314, aircraft turning final runway 25, cleared for immediate takeoff.
PIL: Cleared for takeoff, ACA314.
Q: Which of the following shows the correct order of events for ACA314?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：加航314，短五边B737后，进跑道，跑道25。飞：B737后，进跑道25，加航314。管：加航314，有飞机正转向五边25，可以立刻起飞。飞：可以起飞，加航314。问：以下哪项是加航314正确操作顺序？
choices: Line up, wait then takeoff without delay.
Wait, line up then takeoff without delay.
Line up quickly, wait then takeoff.
Wait until two aircraft have landed then takeoff without delay.
choicesZh: 进跑道，等待，然后立刻起飞。
等待，进跑道，然后立刻起飞。
立即进跑道，等待，然后起飞。
在两架飞机着陆前等待，然后立刻起飞。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wait, line up then takeoff without delay.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, BAW245, 45km southeast of Beijing at 8900m, estimate POLHO at 55, request cross route R343 at POLHO.
CTL: BAW245, Beijing Control, cross R343 at POLHO approved, 55 or before.
Q: When should the pilot cross R343?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，英航245，北京东南方45千米，8900米，预计POLHO 55分，请求在POLHO穿过R343航路。管：英航245，北京区调，同意POLHO 55分或之前穿过R343航路。问：飞行员应该在何时穿过R343航路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No later than 55.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, AFR 214, we have fire in the rear toilet, descending to FL40, request emergency landing, position 45 northwest of..., heading 150.
C: AFR 214, roger MAYDAY. Break, break, all stations, stop transmitting MAYDAY.
Question: What is the current situation of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，AFR 214，我们后部洗手间起火，正在下降至FL40，请求紧急着陆，位置在……西北方向45，航向150。
C: AFR 214，收到MAYDAY。break，break，所有电台，停止发射，MAYDAY。
问题：航空器目前处于什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Distress.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, Dragon Air 306, we just found that some medical supplies are leaking from the cargo compartment. We are coming back and request landing at Wuhan.
C: Dragon Air 306, roger, turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 1500 meters on QNH 1011.
C: Dragon Air 306, what is the type of the medical supply in the aircraft?
P: It is alcohol, Dragon Air 306.
Question: What happened to Dragon Air 306?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，HDA 306，我们刚发现货舱内有一些医疗用品正在泄漏。我们正在返航，请求在武汉着陆。
C: HDA 306，收到，左转航向060，按QNH 1011下降并保持1500m。
C: HDA 306，机上的医疗用品是什么类型？
P: 是酒精，HDA 306。
问题：HDA 306发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Alcohol is leaking from the cargo compartment.
choices: Alcohol is leaking from the cargo compartment.
Bleed air is leaking from the engine compartment.
Hydraulic fluid is leaking from the green system.
Fuel is leaking from the wing tanks.
choicesZh: 发动机舱内有引气泄漏。
绿色液压系统有液压油泄漏。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, request holding instructions.
CTL: CCA102, Beijing, cleared to hold over WG, maintain 8400m, holding inbound track 110 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one and a half minutes, expect further clearance in 10 minutes.
Q: According to the controller, which holding instruction is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，国航102，请求等待指令。管：国航102，北京，可以在WG等待，保持8400米，等待入航边航迹110度，左等待，出航时间1分半，预计等待10分钟。问：根据管制员所说，哪个等待指令是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Holding inbound track 110 degrees.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Control, CSN518, TCAS descent, TCAS indicates fast moving traffic. We are following RA instructions to avoid the conflict.
CTL: CSN518, roger, military activity nearby, possibly a fighter according to its speed.
Q: According to the passage, what should the pilot do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：区调，南航518，TCAS指示下降，TCAS显示快速移动活动，我们正跟随RA指令避开冲突。管：南航518，收到，附近有军事活动，根据速度可能是战斗机。问：根据以上内容，飞行员接下来应怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend following RA instruction.

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Tokyo Departure, Asiana 105, flight control problem, request holding waypoint.
C: Asiana 105, confirm you request holding.
P: roger, we have hydraulic problem, Asiana 105.
C: Asiana 105, roger, request your intention.
P: request stop climb at 10000 and we need holding point, Asiana 105.
Question: Why did Asiana 105 make a PANPAN call?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，东京离场，AAR 105，飞行操纵系统有问题，请求在航路点等待。
C: AAR 105，确认你请求等待。
P: 是的，我们有液压问题，AAR 105。
C: AAR 105，收到，报告你的意图。
P: 请求在10000停止爬升，我们需要等待点，AAR 105。
问题：AAR 105为什么发出PANPAN呼叫？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They had hydraulic problem.
choicesZh: 他们遇到液压系统问题。
他们遇到电气系统问题。
他们遇到增压系统问题。

cards.audioText:
BAW 309, we are unable to control pressurization, cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request immediate descent to FL120.
C: BAW 309, roger, descend to FL120, report reaching.
P: descending to FL120, wilco, BAW 309.
Question: Which level is the aircraft descending to and for what reason?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: BAW 309，我们无法控制增压，客舱高度正在迅速上升，请求立即下降至FL120。
C: BAW 309，收到，下降至FL120，到达后报告。
P: 正在下降至FL120，照办，BAW 309。
问题：航空器正下降至哪个高度层，原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. FL120 due to depressurization.

cards.audioText:
P: London Control, BAW403, we've lost pitch control, we need very long final, request fire services assistant on landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000 feet, heading 250.
C: BAW403, London, continue this heading for the moment. I will position you for a long stretch in the approach immediately.
Q: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：伦敦区调，英航403，我们失去了俯仰控制，我们需要一个长五边，着陆后请求消防援助，当前在跑道入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。管制员：英航403，伦敦，目前保持航向，我马上将给你一个长五边进近。问：飞行员请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A long distance final.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, TWA 123, reaching 900 meters, request surveillance radar approach. C: TWA 123, this will be a surveillance radar approach runway one eight left, terminating at four kilometers from touchdown, obstacle Clearance height 200 meters. Check your minimum.
Question: what approach did the pilot asked for?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉进近，TWA 123，到达900米，请求雷达引导进近。管制员（C）：TWA 123，将为你提供跑道18左的雷达引导进近，终止于距接地点4公里处，障碍清除高度200米。检查你的最低标准。问题：飞行员请求了什么进近方式？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Surveillance radar approach.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3286, surface wind 040 degrees, 4 meters per second, Runway 36L, cleared for takeoff.
P: Runway 36L, cleared for takeoff, CSN 3286.
P: Tower, CSN 3286, takeoff aborted.
C: CSN 3286, roger. Confirm the reasons for aborted takeoff.
P: we have takeoff configuration warning in the cockpit, CSN 3286.
Question: What did CSN 3286 reject takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 3286，地面风040度、4m/s，许可从Runway 36L起飞。
P: 许可从Runway 36L起飞，CSN 3286。
P: 塔台，CSN 3286，中断起飞。
C: CSN 3286，收到，确认中断起飞的原因。
P: 驾驶舱出现起飞构型警告，CSN 3286。
问题：CSN 3286为什么中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to takeoff configuration warning.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Approach, CCA610, anti-icing system unserviceable, request descent.
CTL: CCA610, descend to 2700m and turn left heading 010 to TAN, report reaching.
PIL: Descend to 2700m, heading 010 to TAN, call you reaching, CCA610.
PIL: Level at 2700m, fuel remaining 45 minutes, we can't return, we would like to divert to our alternate, CCA610.
Q: Why does the pilot request divert?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：广州进近，国航610，防冰系统失效，请求下降。管制员：国航610，下2700米，左转航向101直飞TAN，到达后报。飞行员：下2700米，左转航向101直飞TAN，到达后报，国航610。飞行员：在2700米改平，燃油续航45分钟，我们无法返场，我们想改航至备降机场，国航610。问：飞行员为什么请求改航？
choicesZh: 他们遇到了防冰系统问题。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They don't have sufficient fuel.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA101, we are experiencing moderate turbulence on FL148, request descent.
CTL: CCA101, standby. A B737 crossing 10 miles ahead of you at FL138 report no significant turbulence.
Q: What might ATC instruct CCA101 to do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，国航101，高度层148正在经历中度颠簸，请求下降。管：国航101，稍等，前方10海里一架B737在高度层138报告没有明显颠簸。问：ATC下一步可能会给国航101哪项指令？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Descend to FL138.

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CCA102, electrical failure due lightning, emergency circuit still functioning, request divert to the nearest airport.
CTL: CCA102, roger Mayday, cleared to divert to Wuhan, descend to 8100m, turn right heading 090, radar vectors.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is NOT correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉区调，国航102，由于闪电，电气故障，应急电路仍能工作，请求改航到最近的机场。管：国航102，收到Mayday求救信号，可以改航到武汉，下降8100米，右转航向090，雷达引导。问：根据对话，下列哪个选项是错误的？
choices: The aircraft was struck by lightning.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was no backup power.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Approach, CSN3579, we are coming back due anti-icing system unserviceable.
CTL: CSN3579, Guangzhou Approach, roger report your fuel remaining.
PIL: Guangzhou Approach, CSN3579, endurance 40 minutes, request priority landing.
CTL: Negative due CCA102 engine failed, hold at YANGW at 900m, inbound track 163, correction, track 193, right hand pattern, outbound time one minute.
Q: Why CSN3579's request for priority landing is denied?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：广州进近，南方3579，由于防冰系统失效，我们返回来了。管制员：南方3579，广州进近，收到，报告你的燃油续航。飞行员：广州进近，南方3579，续航40分钟，请求优先着陆。飞行员：由于国航102发动机失效，不行，你在YANGW等待，高度900米，入航航迹163.更正，航迹193，有等待，出航时间1分钟。问：南方3579优先着陆的请求为什么被拒绝？
choices: Because CSN3579 encounters anti-icing system failure.
Because there is an aircraft with engine problem.
Because another aircraft declares fuel emergency.
Because CCA102 is at holding pattern.
choicesZh: 因为南方3579遇到了防冰系统失效。
因为有一架航空器遇到了发动机问题。
因为另一架航空器宣布燃油短缺。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because there is an aircraft with engine problem.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, reduce speed to 150kts, you are still too close to the traffic ahead.
PIL: Negative, our minimum approach speed is 160kts, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, roger, turn right heading 010, reposition the localizer.
Q: According to the exchange, what would the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，减速到150节，你和前方活动距离仍然太近。飞：不可以，我们的最小进近速度是160节，国航102。管：国航102，收到，右转航向010，重新截获航道。根据对话，飞行员要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Delay approach.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Delivery, CCA102, request 15-minute delay for takeoff. Two passengers couldn't board due disease outbreak, so we have to off-load their luggage.
CTL: CCA102, roger delay, expedite unloading.
Q: Why did the crew request a delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：放行，国航102，请求延迟15分钟起飞。两名乘客疾病发作无法登机，我们必须卸下他们的行李。管：国航102，收到，加快速度。问：为什么机组请求推迟？
choices: They must unload the overweight luggage.
They must unload the luggage of two passengers.
choicesZh: 机组必须卸下超重行李。
机组必须卸下两名乘客的行李。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They must unload the luggage of two passengers.

cards.audioText:
P: Melbourne center, Speed bird 315, we are unsure of our position, and request vector to the nearest alternate due insufficient fuel, we are maintaining FL110, heading 060,
C: Speed bird 315, Melbourne center, copied your transmission, confirm you wish to call pan, sir?
P: Speed bird 315, affirm, panpan, panpan, panpan.
Q: Why does the pilot request vector to the nearest airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：墨尔本中心，英航315，我们不确定目前位置，由于燃油不足，请求引导至最近备降机场，我们目前保持在高度层110，航向060。管制员：英航315，墨尔本中心，收到你的信息，确认你是否需要呼叫Pan？飞行员：英航315，确认，Panpan，Panpan，Panpan。问：飞行员为什么请求引导至最近的机场？
choices: There is a patient on board.
The port engine is on fire.
His aircraft is running out of fuel.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. His aircraft is running out of fuel.

cards.audioText:
C: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Center, UAL 327, we have smoke warning in the forward cargo hold, request level off at 6000 feet and return to land.
P: UAL 327, roger MAYDAY, maintain 6000 feet.
Question: Why did UAL 327 declare distress?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，区调，UAL 327，我们收到前货舱烟雾警告，请求在6000 feet改平并返回着陆。
P: UAL 327，收到MAYDAY，保持6000 feet。
问题：UAL 327为什么宣布遇险？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to smoke warning in the forward cargo hold.
choices: Due to smoke warning in the forward cabin.
Due to smoke warning in the forward cargo hold.
Due to smoke warning in the flight deck.
Due to smoke warning in the avionics bay.
choicesZh: 由于前客舱出现烟雾警告。
由于前货舱出现烟雾警告。
由于驾驶舱出现烟雾警告。
由于航空电子设备舱出现烟雾警告。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CES205, going around.
CTL: CES205, roger, go around as published.
CTL: CES205, if able, report problem.
PIL: ECAM indicated nose landing gear alignment failure, CES205.
Q: Which of the following might have caused the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京塔台，东方205，复飞。管：东方205，收到，按程序复飞。管：东方205，如有可能，报告问题。飞：ECAM显示前起落架对准失效，东方205。问：东方205复飞是由以下哪个原因引发？
choices: The glide slope was too low.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Nose landing gear deviation.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Control, CSN256, clear of weather, visual an unverified aircraft northeast, our aircraft shook suddenly due wake turbulence.
CTL: CSN256, confirm anything abnormal?
PIL: I will check, standby, CSN256.
Q: According to the passage, what did CSN256 encounter?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：广州区调，南航256，天气没影响，东北方向可见不明飞机，由于尾流我们突然开始晃动。管：南航256，确认一切正常？飞：我会进行检查，稍等，南航256。问：根据内容，南航256遭遇到什么情况？
choicesZh: 由天气引发的严重颠簸。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wake flow from unidentified aircraft.

cards.audioText:
CSN3309, Beijing Control, if you read, squawk ident.
CSN3309, squawk ident observed, check your transmitter, read you one.
CSN3309, turn right 090 and descend to 5400 meters on standard. We'll continue radar control, I read you one.
Q: What problem does CSN3309 have?
cards.audioTextZh: 南航3309，北京区调，如果能听到，应答机识别。南航3309，应答机看到，检查发射机，我听你一个。南航3309，右转090，下降到标准气压5400米，我们将继续雷达引导，我听你一个。问：南航3309遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A transmitter problem.

cards.audioText:
A: The main objective of AIS aerodrome unit is to provide the pilots with aeronautical information for a flight.
B: In fact, it's very important to provide information in such way that it will facilitate self-briefing for pilots to obtain the required information.
Q: What is the main idea of this conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：航空情报服务单位的主要目的是为飞行员提供飞行时所需的航空信息。
B：事实上，以这种方式提供信息是十分重要的，可以促进飞行员通过自我讲评的方式获取所需信息。
问：这段对话的主旨是什么？
choicesZh: 航空情报服务提供的信息。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The function of AIS.

cards.audioText:
