PIL: Beijing Control, UAL782, we have fast moving traffic in front of us. It appears to be a military aircraft. We don't have it on our TCAS, can you see it?
CTL: UAL782, we don't see it on our radar either, probably a fighter without a transponder or not using it.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the pilot's main concern?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，美联航782，前方有快速移动活动，似乎是一架军用飞机。TCAS上没有显示，你能看到它吗？管：美联航782，我们在雷达上也没有看到它，可能是一架没有应答机或不使用应答机的战斗机。问：根据对话，飞行员主要关注的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Conflicting aircraft.

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL782, the Ground came to report that 2 white navigation lights and one strobe light below the APU exhaust off.
PIL: Is that so, we have to check MEL.
PIL: Ground, UAL782, this is not airworthy, we will taxi back to the park for a replacement.
Q: Why did the aircraft taxi back?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：美联航782，地面报告在APU下的2个白色航行灯和1个防撞灯不亮。飞：我们必须要检查MEL。飞：地面，美联航782，飞机不适航，我们将滑行回机位停机进行替换。问：飞机为什么要滑行回机位？
choices: Not in an air operating condition.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Not within MEL requirements.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 316, surface wind 340 degrees 2 m/s, cleared to land Runway 36L.
P: cleared to land Runway 36L, CSN 316.
C: CSN 316, rapid exit E3 is not usable due to construction.
P: roger, CSN 316.
Question: What did the controller advise the pilot of?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 316，地面风340度、2m/s，许可在Runway 36L着陆。
P: 许可在Runway 36L着陆，CSN 316。
C: CSN 316，由于施工，快速脱离道E3不可用。
P: 收到，CSN 316。
问题：管制员提醒飞行员注意什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A rapid exit was not useable.
choices: A rapid exit was not useable.
choicesZh: 一条快速脱离道不可用。
预计较晚收到着陆许可。

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR188, you can't start up now. We had an emergency this morning. The runway had to be foamed and it is being cleaned at the moment.
PIL: Will it be reopened shortly?
CTL: Perhaps in a quarter of an hour, I will call you back.
Q: Why can't the pilot start up?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：法航188，你现在不能开车，今早上发生了紧急事件，跑道喷洒了泡沫，现在正在清理。飞行员：一会儿会重新开放吗？管制员：可能需要15分钟，等下叫你。问：飞行员为什么不能开车？
choices: The runway cleaning is going on.
There is an emergency on runway now.
choicesZh: 跑道上正发生紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The runway cleaning is going on.

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA2712, Beijing Approach, do you need fuel dumping?
PIL: Beijing Approach, ACA2712, we are not equipped with jettison gear, request radar vector for holding to consume some fuel.
CTL: ACA2712, turn right heading 350 to HUR hold as published.
Q: What did the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：加航2712，北京进近，飞机需要放油吗？飞：北京进近，加航2712，飞机未配备放油装置，请求雷达引导等待航线来消耗燃油。管：加航2712，按公布程序右转航向350至HUR等待。问：飞行员想怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Waste fuel before approach.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CSN3342, HM at 35, 9500m, estimating XSH at 50, next HG.
CTL: CSN3342, Wuhan Control, can you lose 5 minutes en route due to traffic separation?
Q: What does the controller want the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：武汉区调，南航3342，HM，高度35，9500米，到XSH时间50分，下一点HG。管：南航3342，武汉区调，由于交通间隔，能否减少5分钟飞行时间？\问：管制员让飞行员做什么？
choices: To keep enough space from the traffic ahead.
To hold at present position for 5 minutes.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To keep enough space from the traffic ahead.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, D303, maintaining 5100 meters. Estimating LKO at 11, information F received.
C. D303 Wuhan Approach, the latest information is G, please check. Report passing LKO.
P: Wuhan Approach, D303, I will check it now and report passing LKO.
Q: What should the pilot do after ATC issues the instructions?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉进近，D303，保持高度5100米，预计到达LKO11分，通播F。管制员：D303，武汉进近，最新通播是G，请确认，过LKO点报。飞行员：武汉进近，D303，我即刻确认，过LKO点报。问：管制员发布指令后，飞行员应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Verify the ATIS.

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW141, Wuhan Ground, hold for a while at holding point C.
PIL: We have been holding for ten minutes already.
CTL: BAW141, there are bird activities on both sides of the upwind.
PIL: Roger. Holding, BAW141.
Q: Why was BAW141 instructed to hold?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：英航141，武汉地面，在等待点C处等一会儿。飞：我们已经等了10分钟。管：英航141，上风两侧有鸟。飞：收到，等待，英航141。问：管制员为何命令飞行员等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Birds over the takeoff path.

cards.audioText:
C: Speed Bird 480 flames coming from your No.3 engine on takeoff. Please advise.
P: Roger, declaring an emergency. Request immediately return, Speed Bird 480.
Q: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：英航480，起飞时候，3号发动机起火，请知晓。飞行员：收到，宣布紧急情况，请求立即返场，英航480。问：为什么宣布紧急情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. engine fire.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW238, ﬂight conditions are getting rough in your area present.
P: Yes, there is severe turbulence in clouds, request offset to the right of the course, BAW238.
C: BAW238, I have received information from previous traffic, flight at 9500 meters are stable.
P: BAW238, request climb 9600 meters.
Q: What was the pilot initial request?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：英航238，你当前区域的飞行条件正在变差。飞行员：是的，云中有强颠簸，请求右偏航，英航238。管制员：英航238，我收到前面飞机的报告，9500米高度很稳定。飞行员：英航238，请求爬升至9600米。问：飞行员的初始请求是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turning to the right.

cards.audioText:
C: ATC clears NWA 146 flight planned track to destination Arch County Standard VORTEX-1 departure, Runway 23R, Squawk 2512. Call radar 125.6 when airborne.
Question: What is the squawk code (=squawk/SSR code)?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 空中交通管制许可NWA 146经计划航路飞往目的地，执行Arch County Standard Vortex 1离场，使用Runway 23R，应答机2512。离地后在125.6联系雷达。
问题：应答机编码是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 2512.

cards.audioText:
P: Sydney delivery, UAL 667, Boeing seven four seven, stand N99, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles. C: Sydney delivery clears UAL 667 to Los Angeles via E Planned route, maintain eight thousand feet, runway two five, SYDNEY-1 departure squawk three zero three four, departure frequency one two three decimal zero. P: Via E plan route, maintain 8000 feet, Runway 25, SYDNEY-1 departure, squawk 3034 and departure frequency 123.0, UAL 667.
Question: which of the following statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：悉尼放行，UAL 667，波音747，停机位N99，申请飞往洛杉矶的空管放行许可。管制员（C）：悉尼放行许可：UAL 667经E计划航线飞往洛杉矶，保持8000英尺，使用跑道25，执行SYDNEY-1 离场程序，应答机3034，离场频率123.0。飞行员（P）：确认经E计划航线，保持8000英尺，跑道25，SYDNEY-1 离场，应答机3034，离场频率123.0，UAL 667。问题：以下哪项陈述正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Altitude 8000 feet, squawk 3034, departure frequency 123.0.
choices: Initial climb 8000 feet, squawk 2034, departure frequency 123.0.
Initial climb 8000 feet, squawk 3034, departure frequency 132.0.
Initial climb 8000 feet, squawk 2034, departure frequency 132.0.
choicesZh: 起始爬升至8,000英尺，应答机编码2034，离场频率123.0。
高度8,000英尺，应答机编码3034，离场频率123.0。
起始爬升至8,000英尺，应答机编码3034，离场频率132.0。
起始爬升至8,000英尺，应答机编码2034，离场频率132.0。

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA108, Beijing Tower, confirm you are approaching runway 18L? It seems that you are on the final of 18R.
PIL: Affirm for 18R. Sorry, we made a mistake. Is runway 18L still available? ACA108.
CTL: ACA108, do you have visual of 18L?
PIL: Affirm, 18L in sight, ACA108.
CTL: ACA108, cleared to land, runway 18L.
Q: Which of the following is most likely true?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：加航108，北京塔台，确认你正在进近跑道18左？似乎你在18右五边。飞：确认跑道18右，抱歉，跑道18左现在可用吗？加航108。管：加航108，跑道18左能见吗？飞：是的，跑道18左能见，加航108。管：加航108，可以在跑道18左着陆。问：以下哪项最有可能是正确的？
choices: The controller issued an incorrect instruction.
The aircraft was over the glide path.
The pilot would continue approach for 18R.
The pilot would adjust approach for 18L.
choicesZh: 飞行员会继续跑道18右进近。
飞行员会调整为跑道18左进近。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The pilot would adjust approach for 18L.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA 1452, ready for departure.
C: CCA 1452, cleared for runway heading and maintain runway heading, climb to 1800m, then turn right enroute. Contact 126.25P: runway heading, 1800m, then turn right enroute. Contact 126.25.
Question: What is NOT mentioned in the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，CCA 1452，准备离场。
C: CCA 1452，许可沿跑道航向飞行并保持跑道航向，爬升至1800m，然后右转加入航路。联系126.25。
P: 跑道航向，1800m，然后右转加入航路。联系126.25。
问题：通话中没有提到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Transponder code.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Harbin Control, CES2301, maintaining FL180, ice building up on windshield, confirm severe icing in the area?
CTL: CES2301, descend to and maintain FL150, severe icing from FL180 upward.
Q: Why should CES2301 descend to FL150?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：哈尔滨区调，东方2301，保持高度层180，风挡上结冰，确认该区域是否有严重积冰？管：东方2301，下降高度层150保持，高度层180以上有严重积冰。问：东方2301为什么要下降高度层150？
choices: Because they are waiting for further instructions.
Because of severe icing over FL180.
Because of severe icing over FL150.
choicesZh: 因为它们正在等待下一步指示。
因为高度层180上有严重积冰。
因为高度层150上有严重积冰。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of severe icing over FL180.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 482, descend to FL290 now for crossing traffic, be leveled at FL290 in two minutes or less.
P: roger, Descend to FL290 in two minutes or less for crossing, leaving FL330 now, NWA 482.
Question: When should they begin their descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 482，为避让穿越航空器，立即下降至FL290，在2分钟或更短时间内在FL290改平。
P: 收到，为避让穿越航空器，在2分钟或更短时间内下降至FL290，现正离开FL330，NWA 482。
问题：他们应在什么时候开始下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Immediately.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, AFR973, we rejected takeoff, the red lights on the panel came on before V1, request vacating runway immediately and we will figure out what's going on.
C: AFR973, vacate runway at your first convenient intersection. Taxi via B6 to No.2 apron.
Q: What reason caused AFR973 to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，法航973，我们中断起飞了，在V1前，面板上的红灯就亮了，请求立即脱离跑道，然后我们看下出什么问题了。管制员：法航973，在最方便的交叉口脱离跑道，通过B2滑行道到2号停机位。问：什么原因导致法航973中断起飞？
choices: Red lights was seen on the runway before V1.
Red lights on another aircraft came out before V1.
Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choicesZh: V1前，其他飞机上发出红灯。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Red warning lights appeared before V1.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, NWA476, request priority landing. We've got a passenger on board who developed a fever and two passengers next to him had slight coughs, suspected swine flu cases.
CTL: NWA476, descend to 3000m, straight in approach runway 18R, first to land.
Q: Why did NWA476 request priority landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京进近，美西北476，请求优先着陆。机上有一名乘客发烧，挨着他的两名乘客轻微咳嗽，疑似感染流感。管：美西北476，下降3000米，跑道18右，直接进近，第一个着陆。问：美西北476为什么请求优先着陆？
choices: There was a suspected case of severe asthma.
A passenger had a slight cough.
There were suspected cases of swine flu.
choicesZh: 机上有人疑似严重哮喘。
机上疑似有人患了流感。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There were suspected cases of swine flu.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, HAD306, we have just found a note on board saying a bomb has been planted in the hold, request landing priority and emergency assistance.
APP: HDA306, Wuhan Approach, roger, descend to 900m, fly heading 050.
Q: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉进近，港龙306，我们在飞机上收到一个便条，称货舱有炸弹，请求优先着陆和紧急救援。管制员：港龙306，武汉进近，收到，下降到900米，航向050。问：飞机上发生了什么？
choices: A passenger on board is very sick.
There is a bomb threat on board.
A note was found in the hold.
There is a bomb on board.
choicesZh: 机上有一名乘客非常不舒服。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a bomb threat on board.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, SAS 996, we've just skidded off taxiway C, and we can't seem to get back onto the paving. Left gear appears to be stuck in the mud. Can you send a tug around? C: SAS 996, standby. Ground handling say there'll be no available tug until 1115.
Question: why does the pilot need a tug?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：地勤，SAS 996，我们刚刚滑出了C滑行道，而且似乎无法回到滑行道的路面上。左侧起落架好像陷在泥里了。能派一辆牵引车过来吗？管制员（C）：SAS 996，请稍等。地勤人员说在11点15分之前没有可用的牵引车。问题：为什么飞行员需要一辆牵引车？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft can not get out of the mud.
choices: There is too much mud on the paving.
The aircraft can not get out of the mud.
The aircraft can not taxi to the runway without a tug.
choicesZh: 没有牵引车飞机就无法滑行到跑道。

cards.audioText:
P: United 350 we cannot hold any longer. We have serious ill passenger on board.
C: United 350 leave the holding pattern fly heading 050.
P: Heading 050, United 350. Request first aid after landing.
C: Roger United 350.
Q: What will be the immediately need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：美联航350，我们不能继续等待，机上有名病重乘客。管制员：离开等待程序，航向050。飞行员：航向050，美联航350，请求落地后急救。管制员：收到，美联航350。问：落地后，立即需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN207, from your present position turn left to taxiway B then taxi to hold point G for change of runway, runway 25, we've just received a report that lighting on runway 31R is unserviceable.
PIL: Taxiway B to hold point G runway 25, CSN207.
Q: Why was CSN207 instructed to turn to taxiway B?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航207，从当前位置左转到滑行道B，然后滑到等待点G改变跑道，跑道25。我们刚收到报告，跑道31右的照明无法使用。飞：从滑行道B滑到等待点G跑道25，南航207。问：为什么南航207接受指令转向滑行道B？
choices: Because the lighting on runway 31R was not available.
Because another aircraft reported a delay vacating runway 31R.
Because there was a problem with taxiway lighting.
choicesZh: 因为跑道31右照明无法使用。
因为另一架飞机报告跑道31右有延误飞机。
因为滑行道照明出现问题。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because the lighting on runway 31R was not available.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 3251, request taxi.
C: CSN 3251, for your information, KAL 236 and CCA 9018 both B747 nearly collided on Runway 14R one minute ago, Stay there now, I will call you back.
P: roger, CSN 3251.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 3251，请求滑行。
C: CSN 3251，提醒你，KAL 236和CCA 9018这两架B747在1分钟前差点于Runway 14R相撞。现在原地等待，我会再次呼叫你。
P: 收到，CSN 3251。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was almost a collision on the runway.
choices: There was a crash on the runway.
There was almost a collision on the runway.
There was a vehicle on the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 1199, Tower, wind 200 at 10 gusting 17 knots, caution wake turbulence, following Boeing 787, cleared to land Runway 24L.
P: cleared to land Runway 24L, ACA 1199.
P: we are going around, ACA 1199.
C: ACA 1199, runway heading, maintain 3000, do you need any assistance?
P: Negative, we had a passenger that ran into the toilet on final, so we can't land, ACA 1199.
Question: What was the reason for ACA 1199 going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 1199，塔台，风向200度、风速10 knots、阵风17 knots，注意尾流，跟随B787，许可在Runway 24L着陆。
P: 许可在Runway 24L着陆，ACA 1199。
P: 我们正在复飞，ACA 1199。
C: ACA 1199，沿跑道航向，保持3000，需要任何协助吗？
P: 不需要，最后进近时有一名乘客跑进洗手间，所以我们无法着陆，ACA 1199。
问题：ACA 1199复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because they had a passenger that ran into the toilet on final.
choices: Because they encountered wake turbulence from Boeing 787.
Because they encountered strong crosswind on final.
Because they had a passenger that ran into the toilet on final.
Because they made an unstable approach on final.
choicesZh: 因为他们遭遇了一架波音787的尾流。
因为他们在五边遭遇强侧风。
因为一名乘客在五边时跑进洗手间。
因为他们在五边进近不稳定。

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CSN 319, request descent. C: CSN 319, descend and maintain 4800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute. P: descend and maintain 4800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute, CSN 319.
Question: What information is not contained?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉管制，CSN 319，请求下降。管制员：CSN 319，下降并保持4800米，下降率每分钟2500英尺。飞行员：下降并保持4800米，下降率每分钟2500英尺，CSN 319。问题：通话中没有包含哪项信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Climb rate.

cards.audioText:
P: Manchester Ground, United 994, we have a hydraulic problem and have lost wheel steering, we will have to hold the position and we request you to send a tug to take us back to the gate
C: Roger, United 994, standby
C: United 994, suggest you shut down your engines, there's a tug on its way.
P: United 994, roger.
Q: What problem does United 994 have?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：曼彻斯特地面，美联航994，我们的液压系统出了故障，失去了转向，我们需要原地等待，请派一辆拖车，将我们拖回停机位。管制员：美联航994，稍等。管制员：美联航994，建议你关闭发动机，拖车在路上了。飞行员：美联航994，收到。问：美联航994出了什么问题？
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A hydraulic problem.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 201, cancel landing clearance Runway 23L due to disabled aircraft, change to Runway 23R.cleared to land 23R.
P: AFR 201, unable to land Runway 23R due to braking problem. We need a longer runway.
Question: Why can't they land on R/W23R?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: AFR 201，由于有航空器故障，取消Runway 23L着陆许可，改用Runway 23R，许可在Runway 23R着陆。
P: AFR 201，由于刹车问题，无法在Runway 23R着陆。我们需要一条更长的跑道。
问题：他们为什么无法在Runway 23R着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They need a longer runway.
choicesZh: 他们需要一条更长的跑道。

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, CCA101, request return to airport, dense smoke coming out of No.4 engine nacelle, suspect fire.
CTL: CCA101, roger MAYDAY. Turn left heading 090.
Q: What might have caused the pilot to request return?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京离场，国航101，请求返回机场，4号发动机舱有浓烟冒出，疑似着火。管：国航101，收到MAYDAY。左转航向090。问：造成飞行员要求返航的原因可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engine cowling fire.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Ground, SIA 521, request taxi.
C: SIA 521, taxi to holding point Runway 36via taxiway Z4, A3 and Alpha.
P: taxi to holding point Runway 36via taxiway Z4, A3 and Alpha, SIA 521.
P: Wuhan Ground, SIA 521, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18.
Question: Why did SIA 521 ask for runway change for departure?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉地面，SIA 521，请求滑行。
C: SIA 521，经滑行道Z4、A3和A滑行至Runway 36等待点。
P: 经滑行道Z4、A3和A滑行至Runway 36等待点，SIA 521。
P: 武汉地面，SIA 521，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用Runway 18。
问题：SIA 521为什么请求更换离场跑道？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because the tailwind was beyond the takeoff limit.
choices: Because the tailwind was beyond the takeoff limit.
Because Runway 36 was closed due to strong tailwind.
Because there was wind shear warning on Runway 36.
Because there was a broken tug on Runway 36.
choicesZh: 因为顺风超过起飞限制。
因为强顺风导致36跑道关闭。
因为36跑道出现风切变警告。
因为36跑道上有一辆故障牵引车。

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, radar contact, maintain 9800m, reduce speed to cross CD 10 or later.
PIL: Roger, request level change to maintain speed, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, no speed restriction on 8400m and 10400m.
Q: Under what circumstance should the pilot reduce speed?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航121，雷达看到，9800米保持，减速到达CD时间10分或以后。飞：收到，请求改变高度保持速度，国航121。管：国航121，8400米到10400米没有速度限制。问：飞行员应该在哪种情况下减速？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. If maintaining 9800 meters.

cards.audioText:
C: SIA223, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
P: Approach, SIA223, we prefer a visual approach to runway 18L; this will save time.
C: Negative, the visibility is too low, you have to make a precision approach, and the glidepath of runway 18L is inoperative.
P: Roger, ILS approach runway 36R.
Q: What is the request for SIA223?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：新航223，预计盲降进近，跑道36右。飞行员：进近，新加坡223，我们更喜欢目视进近，跑道18左，这样会节省点时间。管制员：不同意，能见度过低，你必须做精密进近，同时，跑道18左的下滑道目前不工作。飞行员：收到，盲降进近，跑道36右。问：新航223请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Visual approach runway 18L.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN203, Wuhan Approach. Read you 2. I say again, turn right heading 330 and descend to 4200m.
PIL: Roger, right heading 330 and descend to 4200m, leaving 6000m. We had a lightning strike, suspect some trouble with radios. Operations are normal now, CSN203.
Q: Which of the following problems might the aircraft have encountered?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航203，武汉进近。听你2个。重复一遍，右转航向330，下降4200米。飞：收到，右转航向330，下降4200米，离开6000米。我们遇到雷击，怀疑无线电故障。目前操作正常，南航203。问：飞机可能遇到下列哪种问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio lost.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CES2015, aborting takeoff. Request taxi instruction due hydraulic warning light.
CTL: CES2015, roger, second vacated report.
PIL: First vacated, correction second vacated report, CES2015.
Q: According to the exchange, why did CES2015 abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：武汉塔台，东方2015，中断起飞。液压警示灯亮，请求滑行指令。管：东方2015，收到，第二次脱离时报告。飞：第一次脱离，更正，第二次脱离，东方2015。问：根据对话，为什么东方2015中断起飞？
choices: They had been given incorrect instructions.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They had a hydraulic problem.

cards.audioText:
PIL: CSN309, we have an indication of weather about 40km ahead of us, request turn right to go around it.
CTL: CSN309, negative due prohibit area, turn left 30 degrees, and track out 35km, report clear of the build up.
Q: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：南航309，飞机前方40千米显示有天气情况，请求右转绕开天气。管：南航309，由于禁航区不可以，左转30度，偏离35千米，远离天气后报告。问：管制员要求飞行员怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Turn left 30 degrees.

cards.audioText:
PIL: CCA750, we have a pressurization problem and need to descend to 5100 meters immediately.
CTL: CCA750, unable descend due to high terrain. For descend, turn right heading 060 degrees, expect descend clearance in 10 kilometers.
Q: Why are they unable to descend immediately?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：国航750，飞机增压出现问题，需要立刻下降到5100米。管：国航750，地形影响不能下降。10公里以后下降，右转航向060。问：飞机为什么无法立刻下降？
choices: Cleared to descend at pilot discretion.
choicesZh: 可以飞行员自行决定下。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Unable due to high ground.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN330, Beijing Control, radio check, you didn't report over LADIX as instructed
C: CSN330. Beijing Control.
C: CSN330. If you copy, squawk ident.
C: CSN330, Beijing Control, transmit on 121.5.
Q: What's happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：南方330，北京区调，无线电检查，你没有按指令过LADIX报。管制员：南方330，北京区调。管制员：南方330，如果你能听到，应答机识别。管制员：南方330，北京区调，在121.5频道上发话。问：管制员和飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, passing 9200m.
CTL: CCA102, roger. Are you able to cross INTIK at 0053?
PIL: Affirm, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, cross INTIK 0053 or later due spacing.
Q: When should CCA102 cross INTIK?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，国航102，过9200米。管：国航102，收到。0053时能通过INTIK吗？飞：可以，国航102。管：国航102，由于间隔，0053或之后通过INTIK。问：国航102应该在何时穿过INTIK？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 0053 or later.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA918, unidentified helicopter traffic in this area, 1800m unverified, report traffic in sight.
PIL: Roger, CCA918.
CTL: CCA918, if unable to sight that traffic, hold present position.
PIL: Wilco, CCA918.
Q: Under what condition should CCA918 hold position?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航918，该区域内有不明直升机，1800米未核实，看到它报告。飞：收到，国航918。管：国航918，如不能看到活动，原地等待。飞：照办，国航918。问：在何种情况下，国航918应原地等待？
choices: The flight level of helicopter was unverified.
An identified helicopter blocked the track.
The traffic above 1800 meters was unverified.
choicesZh: 直升机飞行高度未核实。
一不明直升机堵住航道。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The flight level of helicopter was unverified.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Approach, SIA996, we've got a passenger on board with a very serious physical condition. We'll need to land as soon as possible.
CTL: SIA996, descend to 2400m, cleared for straight in approach runway 36.
Q: What does the pilot of SIA996 want to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：进近，新航996，机上一名乘客身体状况恶劣。我们需要尽快着陆。管：新航996，下降2400米，可以直接进近跑道36。问：新航996想做什么？
choices: To have a straight in approach.
To evacuate the passengers on board.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To land quickly.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai Approach, CES5205, we have been struck by lightning, something is wrong with the control system.
CTL: CES5205, roger. Radar indicates you have deviated track. Confirm the rudder is normal?
PIL: Rudder is okay, only the elevator control has a slight problem, we will have a higher approach speed, CES5205.
Q: According to the passage, which part of the aircraft was being in trouble?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：上海进近，东方5205，飞机被闪电击中，操纵系统出现问题。管：东方5205，收到。雷达显示你已偏离航线。确认方向舵正常？飞：方向舵正常，只是升降舵控制有小问题，我们将大速度进近，东方5205。问：根据对话，飞机哪个部分出现了问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Elevator.

cards.audioText:
P: United Airlines 342 we are approaching to the gate.
C: United 342 hold where you are, all the passengers must stay on the board and it has been reported there is bird flu at your departure airport.
Q: What was the reason that the passengers were not allowed to disembark?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：美联航342，我们正在靠近机坪。管制员：美联航342，原地等待，所有乘客待在飞机上，报道称你起飞的机场出现了禽流感。问：乘客不允许下飞机的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Infectious disease.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CES 5402, YIH at 22, 9,800 m, estimating ENH at time 40. CTL: CES 5402, maintain present level and heading, report crossing ENH.
Question: What is the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：管制，CES 5402，22分过YIH，高度9800米，预计40分到达ENH。管制员：CES 5402，保持当前高度和航向，飞越ENH时报告。问题：飞行员正在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Making a position report.
choices: Request clearance to the next point.
choicesZh: 请求前往下一报告点的许可。

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, DAL 303, 8400 meters maintain. We have encountered some turbulence, request 10800 meters. C: DAL 303, one zero thousand eight hundred meters is not available due traffic. Alternative is nine thousand six hundred meters, advise?
Question: which statement is not true?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉管制，达美303，保持8400米。我们遭遇颠簸，请求上升至10800米。管制员（C）：达美303，因空中交通冲突，10800米不可用。可选高度为9600米，是否接受？问题：以下哪项陈述不正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The required level is not available due weather.
choices: The required level is not available due weather.
choicesZh: 管制员建议的高度为9,600米。
由于天气原因，所需高度层不可用。

cards.audioText: Center, CCA 106, we are experiencing moderate icing between FL240 and 260, de-icing equipment is unserviceable, request descend to FL210. CCA 106, descend to FL210, report reaching. Question: What happened to CCA 106?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制，CCA 106，我们在FL240至FL260之间遭遇中度积冰，除冰设备失效，请求下降至FL210。CCA 106，下降至FL210，到达后报告。问题：CCA 106发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They ran into moderate icing and de-icing equipment failed.
choices: They were caught in moderate icing between FL210 and 240.
They ran into moderate icing and de-icing equipment failed.
They were caught in thunderstorm between FL240 and 260.
They were caught in moderate icing and anti-icing equipment failed.
choicesZh: 他们在FL210至FL240之间遭遇中度结冰。
他们遭遇中度结冰且除冰设备失效。
他们在FL240至FL260之间遭遇雷暴。
他们遭遇中度结冰且防冰设备失效。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, AFR126, 8900m maintaining, over DAPRO at 13, estimate LKG 25, next LEH.
CTL: AFR126, radar identified, descend to 5100m before LKG.
PIL: Descend to 5100m before LKG, AFR126.
Q: What was the position of the aircraft at the initial contact?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：武汉区调，法航126，8900米保持，DAPRO上方13分，预计LKG 25分，下个报告点LEH。管：法航126，雷达已识别，LKG前下降到5100米。飞：LKG前下降到5100米，法航126。问：初次通话时飞机的位置在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Over DAPRO.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, JAL 728, the tow bar has bent during push back. We are waiting for them to get another one. C: JAL 728, report when ready to push. But if you take a little bit long time, we have to allocate you a new slot time.
Question: What will happen if the aircraft cannot be pushed back quickly?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：地面，JAL 728，在推出过程中牵引杆断了。我们正在等他们拿另一根来。管制员（C）：JAL 728，准备好推出时报告。但如果你们耗时较长，我们将不得不给你们重新安排一个离场时间。问题：如果飞机不能很快推出，会发生什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They will be delayed for departure.
choices: They will be delayed for departure.
They will have to wait for a new tow bar.
They will have to go back to stand.
choicesZh: 他们必须等待新的拖把。

cards.audioText: GND: Wuhan approach, CCA 101 leaving 2100m descending 900m. ATC: CCA 101 maintain 900m proceed direct to the ILS outer marker and uh weather is uh sky partially obscured, wind calm, fog, and smoke, altimeter 1011, runway one zero, visual RVR less than 300 m. Question: Which of the following is correct according to the conversation above?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉进近，CCA 101离开2100米，下降至900米。管制员：CCA 101，保持900米，直飞ILS外指点标。天气情况为：天空部分被遮蔽、静风、有雾和烟；高度表拨正值1011；使用10跑道；目视跑道视程（RVR）低于300米。问题：根据以上通话，下列哪一项是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. QNH 1011.

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL342, Wuhan Radar, for identification, turn left 30 degrees, heading 360.
PIL: Wuhan Radar, UAL342, we have a transponder on board. Request the transponder code.
CTL: UAL342, squawk 2234.
PIL: Squawk 2234, UAL342.
Q: What does the pilot mean by saying he has a transponder on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：美联航342，武汉雷达，为识别，左转30度，航向360。飞：武汉雷达，美联航342，飞机上有应答机。请求应答机编码。管：美联航342，应答机编码2234。飞：应答机编码2234，美联航342。问：飞行员说到飞机上有应答机时的意图是什么？
choices: To confirm that the transponder is working.
To inform the controller the type of the aircraft.
choicesZh: 通知管制员飞机的类型。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To get a SSR code.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, ACA503, we are coming back due to a burst tyre during gear retraction. Luckily it didn't burst in the well, but the starboard flaps seem to have been damaged.
CTL: ACA503, are you able to manage a flaps-up landing?
PIL: Affirm. Can we use runway 22? It's longer.
CTL: ACA503 is cleared to land runway 22.
Q: What is wrong with ACA503?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：加航503，在收轮过程中，轮胎爆裂，我们现在正在返场，幸运的是，没有在起落架舱爆裂，但是，右侧襟翼看起来受损了。管制员：加航503，你可以进行无襟翼着陆吗？飞行员：确定，我们可以使用22号跑道吗？它更长些。管制员：加航503，可以落地，跑道22。问：加航503出了什么故障？
choices: Tyre burst outside the wheel well.
Tyre burst inside the wheel well.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tyre burst outside the wheel well.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Approach, NWA303, maintaining 5100 meters. Estimating LKG 11, information F received.
CTL: NWA303, Wuhan Approach, the latest information is G, please check it. Report passing LKG
PIL: Wuhan Approach, NWA303, wilco.
Q: What should the pilot do after ATC issues the instructions?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：武汉进近，美西北303，保持5100米。预计到达LKG时间11分，通播F收到。管：美西北303，武汉进近，最新通播G，请核对。过LKG报告。飞：武汉进近，美西北303，照办。问：ATC发布指令后，飞行员应做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Verify the ATIS.

cards.audioText:
P: QFA 235, hold on taxiway A.
C: QFA 235, hold short for departure, you are No 2 after Airbus 320.
P: holding short, No 2 for departure, QFA 235.
C: QFA 235, line up and wait.
P: line up and wait, QFA 235.
Question: What was the departure sequence for QFA 235?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: QFA 235，在滑行道A上等待。
C: QFA 235，在跑道外等待离场，你排在A320之后，是No. 2。
P: 在跑道外等待，离场顺序No. 2，QFA 235。
C: QFA 235，进入跑道等待。
P: 进入跑道等待，QFA 235。
问题：QFA 235的离场顺序是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, AFR 342, we lost pressurization, 9200m descending.
C: AFR 342, roger MAYDAY, break, break, all aircraft below 9200m between PB and MB immediately depart route A593 to the east due to emergency descent.
Question: What does Beijing control instruct all aircraft between PB and MB to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京管制，AFR 342，我们失去增压，正从9200m下降。
C: AFR 342，收到MAYDAY，断开，断开，因有紧急下降，PB和MB之间9200m以下的所有航空器立即向东脱离航路A593。
问题：北京管制指示PB和MB之间的所有航空器做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Leave route A593 to the east.
choices: Depart route A593 to the west.
Leave route A593 to the east.

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, CCA102 heavy, request return to Beijing, rear cabin on fire.
CTL: CCA102 heavy, roger. Confirm dangerous cargo on board?
PIL: We have some chemicals for industrial use in the hold, CCA102.
Q: According to the report, what kind of cargo is on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京区调，国航102重型，请求返回北京，后舱失火。管：国航102重型，收到。确认机上是否有危险物品。飞：货舱内有一些化工用品，国航102。问：根据报告，机上有哪种货物？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Industrial chemicals.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, BAW238, we are not sure our landing gear is down or not.
C: BAW238, your landing gear seems to be completely extended.
P: Wuhan Tower, BAW238, request landing clearance and emergency services.
C: Roger, you're number 1. Previous pilot reported wind shear at 600m 4km, final runway 36R.
P: Roger, number 1 to land, BAW238.
Q: What precaution should the pilot make according to the ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员；塔台，英航238，我们不确定起落架是否放下。管制员：英航238，你的起落架看起来已经完全放下。飞行员：武汉塔台，英航238，请求着陆许可和紧急援助。管制员：收到，你是第一个，之前飞行员报告在跑道36右的五边4公里，高度600米处有风切变。飞行员：收到，第一个着陆，英航238。问：根据管制员信息，飞行员应该做什么防范措施？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wind shear on final.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA104, Beijing Approach, ILS approach runway 36R.
PIL: ILS approach runway 36R, wilco, CCA104.
CTL: CCA104, wind change, right orbit, expect change runway 18R.
PIL: Right orbit, CCA104.
Q: According to the controller, why should the pilot hold?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航104，北京进近，跑道36右盲降进近。飞：跑道36右盲降进近，照办，国航104。管：国航104，风向变化，向右盘旋，预计使用跑道18右。飞：右转盘旋，国航104。问：根据管制员所说，为什么飞行员需要等待？
choices: To give way to departing traffic.
To give way to traffic behind.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wind direction changed.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, taxi to holding point K runway 36L via taxiways A and D, expedite taxi due to traffic at 11 o'clock.
PIL: Wilco, expediting taxi, request cross runway 36R, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, negative.
Q: According to the transmission, what was the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，由于11点钟方向活动，加速滑行经滑行道A和D滑到跑道36左等待点K。飞：照办，加速滑行，请求穿过跑道36右，国航102。管：国航102，不可以。问：根据电文，飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: Expedite taxi to holding point on runway 36R.
choicesZh: 加速滑行至跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cross runway 36R.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Departure, KRU 2633, we have smoke coming from the back of the cabin, request level off at Flight Level 180 and return to land. C: KRU 2633, roger MAYDAY, climb and maintain Flight Level 180, you are Number one to land.
Question: What happened to the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，离场管制，KRU 2633，我们客舱后部有烟雾，请求在FL180改平并返场着陆。管制员：KRU 2633，收到MAYDAY，爬升并保持FL180，你是着陆第一顺位。问题：飞机发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Smoke coming out from the rear cabin.
choices: Smoke coming out from the rear cabin.
Smoke coming out from the front cabin.
Smoke coming out from the avionics bay.
Smoke coming out from the rear toilet.

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL985, be advised runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach to runway 16, circle to land runway 23R. Surface wind 250, 5 gusting to 15, ceiling 340 meters broken.
PIL: UAL985, information copied, checking your minima for approach, will advised.
Q: Why can't they approach runway 23L directly?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：美联航985，跑道23左盲降失效，预计VOR进近跑道16，盘旋着陆跑道23右。地面风风向250，风速5节，阵风15，云底高340米，多云。飞：美联航985，消息已收到，检查进近最低标准。问：飞机为什么不能直接进近跑道23左？
choices: Runway 23L ILS is out of service.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 23L ILS is out of service.

cards.audioText: JAL 309, encountered strong wind shear on final, Runway 21, gained 30 knots between 500 feet and tree hundred feet, followed by a loss of 35 knots between tree hundred feet and surface. Question: what is the height range of the reported windshear?
cards.audioTextZh: JAL 309，在Runway 21最后进近时遭遇强风切变，在500 feet至300 feet之间增速30 knots，随后在300 feet至地面之间减速35 knots。问题：报告的风切变高度范围是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Between 500 feet and the surface.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, Wuhan Tower, radar shows you are 200 feet above glide slope.
P: Tower, CCA 981, roger, we've just lost glide slope indication on the instrument, we are going around as published.
Question: What type of approach was CCA 981 flying before the Missed Approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，武汉塔台，雷达显示你高于下滑道200 feet。
P: 塔台，CCA 981，收到，我们刚刚失去仪表上的下滑道指示，正在按公布程序复飞。
问题：CCA 981复飞前实施的是什么类型的进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ILS.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CCA121, request a tug around, we've just skidded off taxiway C, we can't get back on to the apron, left gear appears to be stuck in the mud.
CTL: CCA121, standby, ground handling says there is no tug available until 1015.
Q: According to the exchange, why did the pilot need a tug?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：地面，国航121，请求拖车，我们刚刚冲出了滑行道C，无法回到停机坪，左起落架似乎陷进泥里。管：国航121，稍等，地勤说到10：15才有拖车可用。问：根据对话，飞行员为什么需要拖车？
choices: The steering system was out of order.
The aircraft could not get out of the mud.
The pilot was not familiar with the taxiway.
choicesZh: 飞行员不熟悉该滑行道。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft could not get out of the mud.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN3206, climb to and maintain 8900m, cruising level 10100m.
PIL: Climb to and maintain 8900m, request 9800m for cruising, CSN3206.
CTL: CSN3206, negative, due to opposite direction, only odd level is available.
Q: Why did ATC reject the pilot's request?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航3206，上升保持8900米，巡航高度10100米。飞：上升保持8900米，请求巡航高度9800米，南航3206。管：南航3206，不可以，由于相对方向，只有奇数高度层可用。问：为什么管制员不同意飞行员的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to opposite direction.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CSN 345.
C: CSN 345, go ahead.
P: There seems to be a bush fire just to the right of our position about 40 miles.
C: Can you give us the exact position please?
P: stand by, we are 25 miles of LKO VOR on the 15o radial
C: position copied, thank you, CSN 345.
Question: Why did Wuhan control want CSN 345's exact position?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉管制，CSN 345。
C: CSN 345，请讲。
P: 我们位置右侧约40 miles处似乎发生了灌木火灾。
C: 请提供准确位置。
P: 稍等，我们位于LKO VOR的15°径向线上，距离25 miles。
C: 位置已记录，谢谢，CSN 345。
问题：武汉管制为什么需要CSN 345的准确位置？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The flight had noticed a bush fire.
choices: The flight had made a position report.
The flight found a crash site.
The flight had a cabin fire.
The flight had noticed a bush fire.
choicesZh: 该航班进行了位置报告。
该航班发现了一处坠机地点。
该航班发现了丛林火灾。

cards.audioText:
P: Winton Control, UA 563, we have been caught in severe turbulence. Would you check the type of aircraft ahead of us?
C: 563, it is a 747. Must be wake turbulence. Climb to FL270.
P: FL 270. Next time, please give us 6 miles at least behind a heavy aircraft.
Question: What does the pilot want the controller to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：温顿区调，美联航563，我们遭遇严重颠簸，你可以证实我们前方的飞机类型吗？管制员：563，是一架747.肯定是因为尾流。爬升至高度层270。飞行员：高度层270，下次，请在重型飞机后，给与我们至少6海里的间隔。问：飞行员想让管制员做什么？
choices: To be aware of the separation.
To tell them there will be a turbulence.
To check the type of aircraft every time.
choicesZh: 告诉他们这里会有颠簸。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To be aware of the separation.

cards.audioText:
C: Qantas 5643, when ready, descend to FL170, report leaving FL220.
P: When ready, descend to FL170, report leaving FL220, Qantas 5643.
C: Qantas 5643, climb immediately FL240.
P: Climb immediately FL240, Qantas 5643.
Q: What was Qantas 5643 initially instructed to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：澳航5643，准备好后，下降到高度层170，离开高度层220后报。飞行员：准备好后，下降到高度层170，离开高度层220后报，澳航5643。管制员：澳航5643，立即爬升到高度层240。飞行员：立即爬升到高度层240，澳航5643。问：澳航5643的初始指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Descend when ready.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3509, Wuhan approach, traffic, 2:00, 7 miles, crossing right to left, Airbus 320, 800 meters below, fast moving. P: CSN 3509, looking.
Question: how could the pilot find the traffic visually?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员（C）：CSN 3509，武汉进近，注意空中目标，方位2点钟方向，距离7海里，从右至左交叉穿越，空客320，下方800米，移动速度快。飞行员（P）：CSN 3509，正在观察。问题：飞行员如何通过目视发现该目标？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Look right downward.

cards.audioText:
P: SF594, over MEL 2000 ft, landing gear down, but maybe not locked. We intend to make a low pass near the tower to have the undercarriage checked. C: SF594, make a low pass at 2000 ft, heading 200, north of tower.
Question: what do the crew intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：SF594，飞过MEL，2000英尺，起落架已放下，但可能未锁定。我们打算在塔台附近低空通场，以便检查起落架。管制员（C）：SF594，以200度航向在塔台以北2000英尺处低空通场。问题：机组人员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Check the landing gear by making a low pass.
choices: Try to extend the landing gear.
Try to lock the landing gear.
Check the landing gear by making a low pass.
Check the landing gear at the present position.
choicesZh: 通过低空通场检查起落架。
在当前位置检查起落架。

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 667, passing 6000ft, request FL250.
C: AFR 667, negative for FL250 for the moment, climb to FL210, expedite until passing FL170, report passing FL170 and FL190.
P: roger, climbing to FL210, and expediting, call you when passing FL170 and FL190, AFR 667.
Question: At which level should AFR 667 slow down climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，AFR 667，正通过6000ft，请求FL250。
C: AFR 667，暂时无法批准FL250，爬升至FL210，加速爬升直至通过FL170，报告通过FL170和FL190。
P: 收到，爬升至FL210并加速爬升，通过FL170和FL190时呼叫你，AFR 667。
问题：AFR 667应在哪个高度层减小爬升率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After passing FL170.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, windshear warning, strong low level windshear observed in the vicinity of Beijing airport at 1400 hours, what's your intention?
P: we'd like to delay our approach 30 minutes, CCA 981.
Question: Why do they want to delay their approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，风切变警告，1400时在北京机场附近观测到强低空风切变，报告你的意图。
P: 我们希望将进近推迟30分钟，CCA 981。
问题：他们为什么希望推迟进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of wind condition.

cards.audioText:
P: CSN306, request 10 degrees heading change to the right of the track to detour the cumulonimbus.
C: Roger, CSN306, turn right 10 degrees, heading 260.
P: Right heading 260, CSN306.
C: CSN306, clear of the CBs now, resume own navigation, report back on track.
Q: Which heading will be suitable for the aircraft come back on track?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：南方306，请求航向右转10度来绕飞积雨云。管制员：收到，南方306，右转10度，航向260。飞行员：右转航向260，南方306。管制员：南方306，现在已避开积雨云，恢复自主领航，回到原航迹后报。问：以下哪个航向可以让飞机回到原航迹？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Turn left.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN1457, caution unscheduled taxiway work near the intersection of taxiway A and L just ahead. Are you able to taxi around that area for full length?
PIL: Affirm, request taxi around the work, CSN1457.
CTL: CSN1457, the alternative is an intersection departure from taxiway K.
PIL: Roger, CSN1457.
Q: According to the controller, which taxiway is the alternative?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：南航1457，注意前方滑行道A和L交叉点附近的计划外施工，你能绕施工区域滑行用全跑道吗？飞：同意，请求绕施工区域滑行，南航1457。管：南航1457，备选从滑行道K交叉点离场。飞：收到，南航1457。问：根据管制员所说，哪条滑行道是备选？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Taxiway K.

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 541, you are cleared to 8100m.
P: We only filed for 7500m, but 8100m is fine if you prefer that altitude.
Question: What was the meaning of the pilot's response?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: QFA 541，许可上升至8100m。
P: 我们只申请了7500m，但如果你希望使用8100m，我们也可以接受。
问题：飞行员的回答是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They accepted 8100.

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, CSN309. Decompression in the cockpit. Request priority landing. We heard a thump, our windshield panel appears to be cracked by hailstones.
CTL: CSN309. Roger PANPAN. Report your position.
PIL: 3 miles DME north of BOBAK at 6000m, CSN309.
CTL: CSN309, follow BOBAK01 Arrival, runway 36L, you are number one.
Q: According to the pilot's report, which is NOT correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，南航309。座舱失压。请求优先降落。我们听到了重击声，风挡好像被雹暴击碎了。管：南航309。收到PANPAN。报告你的位置。飞：BOBAK北部3海里，高度6000米，南航309。管：南航309，BOBAK01进场，跑道36左，你第一个着陆。问：根据飞行员的报告，下列叙述哪个是错误的？
choices: The windshield appears to be cracked.
There's been a sudden loss of cabin pressure.
The pilot is requesting priority landing.
choicesZh: 飞行员正在请求优先降落。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The captain is unconscious.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, JAL785, TCAS descending, we have a fast-moving traffic on my TCAS indication. I am following the TCAS RA instructions to avoid the conflicting traffic.
C: JAL785, I just saw it on my radar. It must be a fighter according to its speed. Report TCAS altitude resumed.
Q: What did the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：管制，日航785，按TCAS下降中，在我们的TCAS上显示有一架快速移动的航空器，我们正按照TCAS决策咨询避让冲突航空器。管制员：日航785，我刚刚在雷达上看到了它，根据其速度，一定是一架战斗机。恢复TCAS高度后报。问：航空器遇到了什么？
choices: An altitude loss on the airborne radar.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An intruder.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA1, taxi to position and hold.
PIL: Tower, large flock of birds at runway 14R.
CTL: CCA1, the birds they are all the time.
PIL: You have alternate runway?
CTL: Runway 27L available expect 15-minute delay.
PIL: CCA1, we will accept the delay.
CTL: CCA1, hold present position, I can't move you yet, opposite direction traffic on T.
Q: Which of the statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航1，滑到位等待。飞：塔台，跑道14右有一群鸟。管：国航1，鸟群无法赶走。飞：有备用跑道吗？管：跑道27左可用，预计15分钟延误。飞：国航1，我们接受延误。管：国航1，当前位置等待，你还不能移动，相反方向T有活动。问：以下哪项陈述是正确的？
choices: Another runway is not available currently.
There is no available alternate runway.
The birds will be moved out of the way.
The delay is too long, so they accept the clearance.
choicesZh: 另一条跑道当前不可用。
延误时间太长，所以他们接受了许可。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Another runway is not available currently.

cards.audioText:
P: Takeoff aborted. Engine two was low on power. Can we vacate 1st left? C: Do you wish to taxi back to the apron or to the threshold of 25? P: Back to Runway 25 please. C: Fine, first left, contact 121.9 for taxi instructions.
Question: what do you learn from the messages?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：中断起飞。二号发动机动力不足。我们能否从第一个左出口脱离跑道？管制员（C）：你希望滑回停机坪还是滑至25号跑道入口？飞行员（P）：请滑回25号跑道。管制员（C）：好的，从第一个左出口脱离，联系121.9获取滑行指令。问题：从对话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The pilot is going to vacate the runway.
choices: The pilot is going back to the apron.
The pilot is going to vacate the runway.
The pilot has a low pressure problem.
The pilot has a taxiing problem.
choicesZh: 飞行员正在返回停机坪。

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Control, turn left back on course immediately due gun-launched area, otherwise you will assume complete responsibility.
PIL: Roger, something is wrong with FMS, turning back, CCA102.
Q: What should the pilot do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，北京区调，由于炮射区立刻左转回到归航，否则你需要承担全部责任。飞：收到，FMS出错，返航，国航102。问：飞行员下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Turn back due to approaching gun-launched area.
Turn back due to approaching prohibited area.
Return to the airport due to FMS failure.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Turn back due to approaching gun-launched area.

cards.audioText:
P: Zhengzhou, CSN309, request descent. The anti-ice system is inoperative.
C: CSN309, descend to 7000m. We had a pilot report 10 minutes ago. There was moderate turbulence at 8000m over ZHO.
P: Down to 7000m. Thanks for the alert, CSN309.
Q: Why does the pilot request descent?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：郑州，南方309，请求下降，防冰系统故障。管制员：南方309，下降到7000米，10分钟前有飞行员报道，ZHO上空8000米处有中度颠簸。飞行员：下降到7000米，感谢提醒，南方309。问：飞行员为什么请求下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because of unserviceable anti-ice system.

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, KLM 332, over TM18, estimating DA26, descending to 2400 meters on QNH. C: KLM 332, direct to DA, and hold at DA as published, due runway incursion accident. Expect approach clearance at 55.
Question: Why was KLM 332 instructed to hold at DA?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：进近管制，KLM 332，飞越TM18，预计26分钟到达DA，按QNH下降至2400米。管制员：KLM 332，直飞DA，并按公布程序在DA等待，因跑道侵入事故。预计55分钟提供进近许可。问题：为什么KLM 332被指示在DA等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due ground accident.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, SIA 205, 45km southwest of LKO at 8,900m, estimating LKO at time13, request clearance to cross airway R343 at LKO. C: SIA 205, Wuhan Control, cleared to cross R343 at LKO at time13 or before, maintain 8,900m.
Question: When should the pilot cross the route?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉管制，SIA 205，位于LKO西南45公里、高度8900米，预计13分到达LKO，请求许可在LKO穿越R343航路。管制员：SIA 205，武汉管制，许可在13分或之前于LKO穿越R343，保持8900米。问题：飞行员应在什么时候穿越该航路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No later than 13.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CSN6104, No.2 engine failure, request back to apron.
CTL: CSN6104, roger, is there any other problem?
PIL: Affirm, APU inoperative, the crossbleed valve malfunctioned, request taxi back via shortest route, CSN6104.
Q: Which problem did the pilot NOT report?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京地面，南航6104，二发失效，请求返回停机坪。管：南航104，收到，还有其他问题么？飞：是的，APU失效，交输活门故障，请求按最短路线滑行回停机坪，南航6104。问：飞行员未报告哪种问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Pressurization.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tianjin Ground, CCA410, stand 203, information J, request ATC clearance.
CTL: CCA410, cleared to Shanghai flight planned route, follow ANRAT 2D departure, initial climb to 2100m, after departure, contact 127.9, squawk 5345.
Q: What are the SID and transponder code?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：天津地面，国航410，机位203，通播J，请求ATC许可。管：国航410，可以按计划航路飞往上海，ANRAT 2D离场，起始高度2100米，离场联系127.9，应答机5345。问：标准离场程序和应答机编码是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. ANRAT 2D and 5345.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, request going on the CBs in the right.
CTL: CCA101, negative due to prohibited area, turn left 40 degrees and track out 30km. Report clear of the CBs.
Q: Why was CCA101 not allowed to turn to right?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：武汉区调，请求绕开右侧积雨云。管：国航101，由于禁航区不可以，左转40度航行30千米，避开天气后报告。问：为什么不允许国航101右转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area.

cards.audioText:
C: United347, descend immediately due to traffic, a Boeing 747 is closing on you.
P: Control, United airlines 347. Our resolution advisory direct to climb to avoid the traffic, the traffic ahead of us is descending.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：美联航347，由于航空器，立即下降，一架波音747正在接近你。飞行员：区调，美联航347，我们的决策咨询指示我们爬升来避开航空器，前方的航空器正在下降。问：发生了什么？
choices: Controller instructed both aircraft to descend.
TCAS indication agreed with ATC instruction.
TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.
choicesZh: 决策咨询指示美联航347下降。
管制员指示两架飞机下降。
TCAS指示和管制员指令一致。
TCAS指示和管制员指令冲突。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.

cards.audioText:
C: CES147, do you want medical personnel to meet you at the gate or on the taxiway after you exit the runway,
P: CES147, we exit on N, we'd like medical personnel to meet us there.
Q: Where does CES147 want the medical personal to meet them?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：东方147，你脱离跑道后，是希望医疗人员去停机坪还是去滑行道上？飞行员：东方147，我们在N点脱离，我们希望医疗人员在那里和我们碰面。问：东方147希望医疗人员在哪里和他们碰面？
choices: At the end of the runway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. On taxiway November.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Control, NWA 808, emergency descend due to rapid depressurization. Now, 8,400 m descending to 4,200 m. Request priority landing at your field. C: NWA 808, Wuhan Control, roger Mayday. Descend to 3,900 m. P: Descend to 3,900 m. NWA 808. C: All stations, emergency descent in progress from 8,400 m over HZ, all aircraft below 8,100 m in the vicinity of HZ leave this area to the east immediately and contact 123.15.
Question: Which aircraft will change the frequency?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，管制，NWA 808，由于快速失压紧急下降。现高度8400米，正在下降至4200米。请求在你方机场优先着陆。管制员：NWA 808，武汉管制，收到MAYDAY。下降至3900米。飞行员：下降至3900米，NWA 808。管制员：所有电台，HZ上空正在从8400米实施紧急下降，HZ附近8100米以下的所有航空器立即向东离开该区域，并联系123.15。问题：哪些航空器将改变频率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Aircraft below 8,100 m near HZ.
choices: Aircraft in the vicinity of HZ.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, Gate 5, request push back and start up. C: CCA 102, standby. Because large passes of cumulonimbus along the route. Separation of the same direction is 200 kilometers. Expect at least 30 minutes delay. Call you back. P: Roger, CCA 102.
Question: Why will CCA 102 be delayed?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉塔台，CCA 102，5号登机口，请求推出和启动发动机。管制员（C）：CCA 102，稍等。因航路上有大范围积雨云，同向间隔需保持200公里，预计至少延误30分钟。将回电通知你。飞行员（P）：收到，CCA 102。问题：CCA 102为何将延误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to traffic congestion.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Departure, CCA102, passing 1200m, climbing to 4500m.
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Departure, radar shows you squawking 4261, squawk 4621 and reconfirm your level.
PIL: Apologies, now squawking 4621, passing 2100m, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, roger.
Q: What should the aircraft's transponder code be?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京离场，国航102，正通过1200米，上升到4500米。管：国航102，北京离场，雷达显示你的应答机编码为4261，改变编码为4621并重新确认你的高度。飞：抱歉，现在应答机编码为4621，通过2100米，国航102.管：国航102，收到。问：飞机的应答机编码应该是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Squawk 4621.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, BAW782, we have a fast-moving traffic in front of us. It looks like a fighter from here. We don't have it on our TCAS, have you observed it?
C: We didn't see it on our radar either, probably a fighter without a transponder or not using transponder.
Q: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh: 武汉区调，英航782，我们前方有一架快速移动的航空器，从这儿看起来像是一架战斗机，我们在TCAS上没有看到它，你们观察到它了吗？管制员：我们在雷达上也没有看到它，或许是一架没有发射机或者不使用发射机的战斗机。问：他们在讨论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Conflicting aircraft.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 344, approve to taxi via taxiway B to holding point runway three six left. P: Taxiway B, three six left, Roger, CSN 344. P: Ground, CSN 344, request return to the apron due to malfunction indication of hydraulic system. Present position, intersection of taxiway B and C. C: 344, hold your position.
Question: why does the pilot want to go back to the apron?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员（C）：CSN 344，允许经滑行道B滑至36左跑道等待点。飞行员（P）：滑行道B，36左，收到，CSN 344。飞行员（P）：地面，CSN 344，因液压系统故障指示，请求返回停机坪。当前位置：滑行道B与C交汇处。管制员（C）：344，原地等待。问题：飞行员为何想返回停机坪？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because there is some mechanical problem.
choices: Because there is a malfunction of instruments.
Because there is some mechanical problem.

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL567, confirm speed 250kts, your speed still higher than the preceding aircraft.
PIL: Unable to reduce to 250kts due high rate of descent, UAL567.
CTL: UAL567, roger, turn right heading 340 for reposition on the localizer.
Q: According to the exchange, what would the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：美联航567，确认速度250节，你的速度仍大于前方飞机。飞：由于大下降率，无法减速到250节，美联航567。管：美联航567，收到，右转航向340重新截获航道。问：根据对话，飞行员会怎样做？
choices: Catch up with aircraft in front.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Delay localizer capture.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CCA 4106, we have just encountered the severe turbulence, 2 passengers were severely injured, and 1 passenger with heart attack.
C: CCA 4106, confirm you declare PANPAN, report your intention.
P: Yeah, we want to declare a PANPAN, and request priority landing at Wuhan airport.
C: CCA 4106, you are number 1, radar vector, turn left heading 150, expedite descend and maintain 4200m.
Question: Which of the following is not true according to the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉管制，CCA 4106，我们刚遭遇严重湍流，2名乘客严重受伤，另有1名乘客心脏病发作。
C: CCA 4106，确认你宣布PANPAN，报告你的意图。
P: 是的，我们要宣布PANPAN，并请求优先在武汉机场着陆。
C: CCA 4106，你是No. 1，雷达引导，左转航向150，加速下降并保持4200m。
问题：根据这段通话，以下哪一项不正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Three passengers were seriously injured in the turbulence.
choices: Three passengers were seriously injured in the turbulence.
choicesZh: 三名乘客在颠簸中受重伤。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shenyang Control, CCA1463, de-icing equipment failure, request descent to 7500m or lower.
CTL: CCA1463, maintain present level for 02 minutes due to traffic.
PIL: Negative, leading edges iced over, request immediate descent, CCA1463.
CTL: CCA1463, roger, turn right heading 090, descend to 6300m.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：沈阳区调，国航1463，除冰故障，请求下降到7500米或更低。管：国航1463，由于活动，保持当前高度2分钟。飞：不同意，前缘结冰，请求立即下降，国航1463。管：国航1463，收到，右转航向090，下降到6300米。问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: There is probably ice above 7500 meters.
There is probably ice above 6300 meters.
The aircraft will descend 2 minutes later.
The wind shear is iced over.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is probably ice above 7500 meters.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Nanjing Approach, CSN3501, cabin on fire.
CTL: CSN3501, Nanjing Approach, report fire position and condition.
PIL: The rear aisle carpet is on fire. Someone set fire to the petrol in a can.
Q: What is the reason of the on-board fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：南京进近，南方3501，客舱起火。管制员：南方3501，南京进近，报告起火位置和情况。飞行员：后舱过道地毯起火，有人点着了易拉罐里的汽油。问：机上起火的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Someone set the fire deliberately.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 347, descend immediately due to traffic, a B737 is closing on you.
P: Control, UAL 347, our resolution (TCAS RA) advises us direct to climb to avoid the traffic. The traffic ahead is descending.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 347，由于冲突航空器立即下降，一架B737正在接近你。
P: 管制，UAL 347，我们的决断咨询（TCAS RA）指示我们立即爬升以避让冲突航空器。前方航空器正在下降。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.
choices: TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.
Controller instructed both aircraft to descend.
TCAS indication agreed with ATC instruction.
choicesZh: TCAS指示与空管指令相冲突。
管制员指示两架飞机都下降。

cards.audioText:
A: Captain did you find some problem here in the cockpit?
B: Come here, look at the right-side chair, it is not moveable.
A: Let me check. Oh, yes, ok, the control lever is too tight. I am going to fix it. It won't take long.
B: The chair must be adjusted to the proper position to obtain the best reference position.
Q: Why should the chair be put in a proper position?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：机长，你发现驾驶舱里出问题了吗？
B：过来，你看看，右侧的座椅动不了了。
A：我来检查下，嗯，是，控制手柄太紧了，我这就处理，花不了很久。
B：座椅必须调节到最佳位置，来获得最佳目视基准位置。
问：座椅为什么需要调节到合适的位置？
choices: To get the most eye reference.
To get the biggest eye reference.
To get the optimum eye reference.
To get the highest eye reference.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To get the optimum eye reference.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, ACA5261, I've intercepted Mayday from CCA5336, I say again, CCA5336, double engine failure, forced landing, current position 10 miles east of LADIX, over.
CTL: ACA5261, roger your relayed mayday from CCA5336.
Q: What do you learn from the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，加航5261，我收到国航5336的Mayday信息，我再说一遍，国航5336，双发失效，准备迫降，目前位置在LADIX以西10海里，完毕。管制员：加航5261，收到你转发的国航5336的Mayday信息。问：我们可以从对话中得到什么信息？
choices: Air Canada has two engines failed.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Air China has an emergency.

cards.audioText:
P: CCA 982, we are unable to lower the landing gear, request proceed to hold to have a complete check.
P: CCA 982, flaps are still jammed, we have manually cranked down the main gear, but not the nose gear, request emergency landing.
C: CCA 982, set heading to LR, and hold, report when ready to leave.
Question: What does the crew request initially?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: CCA 982，我们无法放下起落架，请求前往等待航线进行全面检查。
P: CCA 982，襟翼仍然卡住，我们已用手摇方式放下主起落架，但前起落架尚未放下，请求紧急着陆。
C: CCA 982，飞向LR并等待，准备离开时报告。
问题：机组最初提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Join the holding pattern for check.
choices: Join the holding pattern for check.
Make a low pass for visual check.
choicesZh: 加入等待航线进行检查。
低空通场以便目视检查。

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, QFA 332, we are approaching the holding point. C: QFA 332, taxi into position and hold. Caution wake turbulence of the departing aircraft. Stand by for departure. P: Taxi into position and hold.
Question: What should the pilot be careful about?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，QFA 332，我们正在接近等待点。管制员：QFA 332，进跑道对正并等待。注意前方离场航空器的尾流，等待起飞。飞行员：进跑道对正并等待。问题：飞行员应该注意什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wake turbulence of departure aircraft.
choicesZh: 离场航空器的尾流颠簸。
离场航空器的微弱颠簸。

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Urumqi Control, AFR561, request immediate descent, we're running into dust cloud, possible volcanic ashes, No.2 engine flame out.
CTL: AFR561, roger, descend to 8100m.
Q: What might the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，乌鲁木齐区调，法航561，请求立即下降，我们遇到尘雾，有可能是火山灰，2发熄火。管：法航561，收到，下降8100米。问：这架飞机可能遇到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Volcanic ash.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, SIA 303, we have just been struck by lightning, the right outboard aileron was damaged. C: SIA 303, make sure there's no other damage to the aircraft. P: I am checking now. I will inform you later. P: Wuhan Control, SIA 303, we have hydraulic problem. The rudder is jammed
Question: What failures did SIA 303 have?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：武汉管制，SIA 303，我们刚遭到雷击，右侧外副翼受损。管制员：SIA 303，确认飞机没有其他损伤。飞行员：我正在检查，稍后通知你。飞行员：武汉管制，SIA 303，我们的液压系统有问题，方向舵卡住了。问题：SIA 303发生了哪些故障？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of above.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, Beijing Approach, KM01 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, descend to 2700m on QNH 1011, preceding aircraft reported there were thunderstorms in your inbound track.
PIL: KM01 arrival, ILS runway 36R, descend to 2700m on QNH 1011, build-ups ahead, request deviate 10 miles right of track, CCA101.
Q: According to the exchange, where were the thunderstorms in relation to CCA101?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航101，北京进近，KM01进场，跑道36右盲降进近，下降到修正海压2700米，修正海压1011，前方飞机报告向台航迹上有雷暴。飞：KM01进场，跑道36右盲降进近，下降到修正海压2700米，修正海压1011，雷暴正在形成，请求右偏10海里，国航101。问：根据对话，雷暴和国航101的距离是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Distance not mentioned.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CES 525, go around, no contact at minimal. C: CES 525, climb and maintain nine thousand meters, fly heading zero six zero, contact approach on one one niner decimal zero five.
Question: why did CES 525 pull up?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：塔台，CES 525，复飞，最低高度无目视参考。管制员（C）：CES 525，爬升并保持9000米，航向060，联系进近119.05。问题：CES 525为何复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. runway not in sight at minimum.
choices: runway not in sight at minimum.
choicesZh: 未与进近管制取得联系。
在最低标准处未见跑道。

cards.audioText:
P: SIA 3478, request low approach for visual check of the landing gear. C: SIA 3478, cleared low approach Runway 28 not below 400ft above threshold elevation, report final. P: Cleared low approach Runway 28 not below 400ft above threshold elevation, wilco, SIA 3478.
Question: Why does SIA 3478 request a low approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：SIA 3478，请求低空进近，以便目视检查起落架。管制员：SIA 3478，许可对28号跑道实施低空进近，通过跑道入口时不得低于跑道入口标高以上400英尺，报告最后进近。飞行员：许可对28号跑道实施低空进近，通过跑道入口时不得低于跑道入口标高以上400英尺，照办，SIA 3478。问题：SIA 3478为什么请求低空进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Possible undercarriage problem.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Control, descend to FL260, thunderstorms reported 20 miles ahead of you.
PIL: Roger, request proceed offset 10 miles right of track, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, approved, when cleared of weather, direct to VYK.
Q: What did the crew request?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，北京区调，下降高度层260，报告显示你前方20海里处有雷暴。飞：收到，请求右偏10海里，国航102。管：国航102，同意，天气好转后，直飞VYK。问：机组做了什么请求？
choices: Right divert 10 miles due to storm activity.
Left divert 10 miles due to storm activity.
Right divert 20 miles due to storm activity.
choicesZh: 由于风暴活动，右偏航迹10英里。
由于风暴活动，左偏航迹10英里。
由于风暴活动，右偏航迹20英里。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Right divert 10 miles due to storm activity.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, CSN3308, holding short of runway 36 right.
CTL: CSN3308, line up after the landing 747, number two for departure.
PIL: Roger, looking for traffic, traffic in sight. CSN3308.
Q: What is the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：塔台，南航3308，跑道36右等待。管：南航3308，在着陆的747后进入跑道，第二个离场。飞：收到，正在寻找活动，活动可见，南航3308。问：飞行员正在做什么？
choices: Waiting to get on the runway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Waiting to get on the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: United 342 encountering severe icing at altitude 5400m. What altitude do you recommend?
C: United 342 we have several pilot reports which said that 4200m is clear of ice.
P: We request to descend 4200m, United 342.
Q: Where did the controller get the information for no ice level?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：美联航342，遇到强积冰，高度5400米。建议飞多高？管制员：美联航342，收到多个飞行员报告称在4200米没有积冰。飞行员：请求下降到4200米，美联航342。问：管制员从哪里得到的没有积冰的信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. PIREP.

cards.audioText:
NWA 18 is taxiing to Runway 23R via taxiway TP: NWA 18, holding short of Runway 16.
C: NWA 18, couldn't cross runway for a... delay, traffic 3 miles final.
P: NWA 18, unable to expedite, we are stopped.
C: NWA 18, hold short of Runway 16, taxiing clearance cancelled.
P: NWA 18, holding short.
Question: Describe what happened.
cards.audioTextZh:
NWA 18正经滑行道T滑向Runway 23R。
P: NWA 18，在Runway 16外等待。
C: NWA 18，能否立即穿越跑道？有航空器在3 miles最后进近。
P: NWA 18，无法加速，我们已经停下。
C: NWA 18，在Runway 16外等待，滑行许可取消。
P: NWA 18，在跑道外等待。
问题：描述发生了什么。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They didn't accept the clearance to cross.
choices: They were going too fast to stop.
They crossed RW 16 and are holding short of taxiway T.
They expedited their taxi across RW 16.
They didn't accept the clearance to cross.
choicesZh: 他们速度太快，无法停下。
他们已穿越16跑道，正在T滑行道外等待。
他们加速滑行穿越了16跑道。
他们没有接受穿越许可。

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Beijing Control, CCA981, smoke coming from engine bleed air system, we suspect that something is on fire, we have dropped the oxygen masks.
CTL: CCA981, roger Mayday, you are cleared to return, descend at your own discretion, what is your intention?
PIL: We're examining the mechanism and trying to locate the fire, request priority landing, CCA981.
Q: Which of the following is not true?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday Mayday Mayday，北京区调，烟雾从发动机引气系统冒出。我们猜测有东西着火了，我们必须释放氧气面罩。管制员：国航981，收到Mayday，可以返航，自行下降，你的意图是什么？飞行员：我们正在检查机制，尝试定位起火点，请求优先着陆，国航981。问：以下哪一个是不正确的？
choices: The aircraft is in distress situation.
The pilot has determined the location of the fire.
The pilot will land with priority.
choicesZh: 飞行员已经确定了起火位置。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The pilot has determined the location of the fire.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR201, cancel landing clearance runway 23L due to disabled aircraft, change runway 23R. Cleared to land runway 23R.
P: AFR201 unable to land runway 23R due to brake problem. We need the longer runway.
C: AFR201, go around immediately. Turn left heading 140 for vector ILS runway 23L, climb and maintain 4000 feet. The runway will be available in 5 minutes.
Q: Why can't they land on runway 23R?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：法航201，由于航空器损坏，取消跑道23左的着陆许可，改成跑道23右，可以着陆，跑道23右。飞行员：法航201，由于刹车系统故障，无法使用跑道23右着陆。我们需要更长的跑道。管制员：法航201，立即复飞，左转航向140，引导至跑道23左盲降，爬升并保持4000英尺，跑道在5分钟以后可用。问：为什么不能在跑道23右降落？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They need a longer runway.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, AFR 973, we reject takeoff due red lights on the panel came on before V1, request vacating runway immediately, the figure is going on.
C: AFR 973, via first convenient intersection. Taxi via B6 to No. 2 apron.
Question: What reason caused AFR 973 to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，AFR 973，由于在V1前面板上的红色警告灯亮起，我们中断起飞，请求立即脱离跑道，警报仍在持续。
C: AFR 973，从第一个方便的交叉口脱离，经B6滑行至No. 2停机坪。
问题：什么原因导致AFR 973中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choices: Red lights were seen on the runway before V1.
Red lights on another aircraft came out before V1.
Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choicesZh: 在达到V1前看到跑道上有红灯。
另一架飞机的红灯在达到V1前亮起。
在达到V1前出现了红色飞行物。
在达到V1前出现了红色警告灯。

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, turn right heading 260, direct to HG, resume own navigation.
PIL: Turn right heading 260, direct to HG, resume own navigation. Confirm resume normal speed 280kts, CCA121.
CTL: Negative, CCA121, maintain speed 250kts due spacing.
Q: According to the instruction, at what speed should the pilot fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航121，右转航向260，直飞HG，恢复自主领航。飞：右转航向260，直飞HG，恢复自主领航。确认恢复正常速度280节，国航121。管：不可以，国航121，由于间隔，保持速度250节。问：根据指令，飞行员应该用什么速度飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 250kts.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, CCA 4307, 4000m descending to 2700m. We have seen a big white balloon ahead of us 30km from left to right.
C: CCA 4307, roger. Radar not contact with the balloon, what's your intention?
P: Roger, we need to turn left to avoid the balloon, CCA 4307.
C: CCA 4307, roger, cleared to turn left to avoid the balloon, report clear of the balloon.
Question: What can we learn from the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，CCA 4307，高度4000m，正在下降至2700m。我们看到前方30km处有一个白色大气球，正从左向右移动。
C: CCA 4307，收到。雷达未发现该气球，报告你的意图。
P: 收到，我们需要左转避让该气球，CCA 4307。
C: CCA 4307，收到，许可左转避让气球，避开后报告。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. CCA 4307 reported a big white balloon from its left to right.
choices: CCA 4307 reported a big white balloon from its left to right.
CCA 4307 requested right turn to avoid the reported balloon.
The controller has seen the reported balloon on the radar.
The controller didn't approve CCA 4307's request to turn left.
choicesZh: CCA 4307报告一个大白色气球从左向右飘过。
CCA 4307请求右转避让所报告的气球。
管制员已在雷达上看到所报告的气球。
管制员未批准CCA 4307左转的请求。

cards.audioText:
P: United 655 we have serious fuel leak, we are returning.
C: United 655 descend 3300 meters.
P: Leaving 5400 meters for 3300 meters, United 655.
C: United 655, do you require emergency assistant on landing?
P: Affirm, United 655.
Q: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：美联航655，飞机出现严重燃油泄漏，我们正在返航。管制员：美联航655，下降到3300米。飞行员：离开5400米到3300米，美联航655。管制员：美联航655，你需要在落地后请求紧急援助吗？飞行员：是的，美联航655。问：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Fuel leak.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, this is JAL 783, 9200m maintaining. Just now we have a male passenger attempted to enter the cockpit.
C: JAL 783, Wuhan Control, roger, report the situation.
P: The first officer has been sent out to check it out, I'll keep you informed, JAL 783.
P: The first officer just came back and he said that the passenger is very aggressive, it seems that he has taken some drugs. While being escorted back to his seat, the passenger attacked other passengers.
Question: What happened to JAL 783?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉管制，我是JAL 783，保持9200m。刚才一名男性乘客试图进入驾驶舱。
C: JAL 783，武汉管制，收到，报告情况。
P: 已派副驾驶出去查看，我会随时向你报告，JAL 783。
P: 副驾驶刚刚回来，他说该乘客非常具有攻击性，看起来像服用了一些毒品。在被护送回座位时，该乘客袭击了其他乘客。
问题：JAL 783发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. JAL 783 encountered unlawful interference.
choices: A male passenger entered the cockpit.
Other passengers attacked the male passenger.
choicesZh: 一名男性乘客进入驾驶舱。
其他乘客袭击了该男性乘客。

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, HDA305, we cannot extend the nose gear due to a hydraulic problem. Request making a low pass for a visual check.
C: HDA305, make a low pass not below 45m over the runway 36.
Q: What is the level for low pass?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：塔台，港龙305，由于液压系统故障，我们无法释放前起落架，请求低空通常进行目视检查。管制员：港龙305，在跑道36上空做低空通场，高度不低于45米。问：低空通场的高度是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of the other choices.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA201, leaving FL250 for FL200.
CTL: CCA201, Beijing Control, your transmission is partly broken up. Confirm leaving flight level 240?
PIL: Negative. We're leaving 250. I say again 250, CCA201.
CTL: CCA201, roger.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，国航201，从高度层250离开下降到高度层200。管：国航201，北京区域，通讯有断续，确认离开高度层240？飞：不同意，我们正离开250，我重复一遍250，国航201。管：国航201，收到。问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The controller made a wrong instruction.
The pilot made a mistake in transmitting.
The controller had trouble reading the transmission.
choicesZh: 飞行员在传送时出现错误。
管制员在接收电文时遇到问题。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The controller had trouble reading the transmission.

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Departure, American 2562, we need to return to Phoenix, we have low oil quantity in one of our engines.
C: American 2562, roger PANPAN, you are cleared to the Sky Harbor Airport via radar vector, maintain 10000.
P: maintain 10000, American 2562.
Question: What happened to American 2562?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，离场，AAL 2562，我们需要返回Phoenix，一台发动机的滑油量低。
C: AAL 2562，收到PANPAN，许可经雷达引导飞往Sky Harbor Airport，保持10000。
P: 保持10000，AAL 2562。
问题：AAL 2562发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They have low oil quantity in one of the engines.
choices: They have low oil pressure in one of the engines.
They have low oil quantity in one of the engines.
They have low fuel quantity in one of the engines.
They have low fluid quantity in one of the engines.
choicesZh: 他们的一台发动机滑油压力低。
他们的一台发动机滑油量低。
他们的一台发动机燃油量低。
他们的一台发动机液体量低。

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, BAW303, left engine on fire. Emergency slides are released, request fire services and first aid.
C: BAW303, roger mayday, airport emergency assistance services will be notified.
Q: What has the crew done already?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，英航303，左发起火，紧急滑梯已释放，请求消防车和急救。管制员：英航303，收到Mayday，将通知机场紧急救援服务部门。问：机组已经做了什么？
choices: Released fire bottles on right engine.
choicesZh: 释放消防车上的灭火器。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Begun the evacuation procedures.

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, CCA 320, B747, we have shut down No. 2 engine due to excessive vibration, heading now 120 degrees, 600m, current position 20 miles east of HJU, request return to your airport for immediate landing.
Question: What type of aircraft was CCA 320?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，CCA 320，B747，由于振动过大，我们已关闭No. 2发动机。当前航向120度、高度600m，当前位置在HJU以东20 miles，请求返回你机场立即着陆。
问题：CCA 320是什么机型？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Boeing 747.

cards.audioText:
P: Good afternoon, sir.
Officer: Good afternoon. What can I do for you?
P: Yes, I am the captain of UAL303. I would like to check the weather information. When can we depart?
Officer: The thunderstorm is cleared away, and you can depart as scheduled.
P: Thank you.
Q: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：先生，下午好。长官：你好，有什么可以帮到你的吗？飞行员：是的，我是美联航303的机长，我想确认下天气信息，我们何时可以起飞？长官：雷暴天气已经消散，你可以按计划起飞。飞行员：谢谢。问：他们在讨论什么？
choices: When the pilot can leave the office.
choicesZh: 飞行员何时离开办公室。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Weather information.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141 continue on the inner, at M join the outer, cross Three One Left at K. P: OK, by the inner and M outer and KA, cross Three One Left, BAW 141.
Question: what is the controllers taxiing instructions?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 141，继续沿内侧滑行，在M点切入外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31左跑道。飞行员：好的，沿内侧滑行，经M外侧和K点，穿越31左跑道，BAW 141。问题：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K.
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M.
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K.
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K.
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K.
choicesZh: 经K到内侧和外侧滑行道，在M点穿越31L跑道。
沿内侧滑行道，经M到外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道。
经M到外侧和内侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道。
经M到内侧和外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道。

cards.audioText:
CTL: NWA808, Control, we have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft. Report your intention.
PIL: NWA808, in that case, we'd like to land at your field.
CTL: NWA808, descend to 4,500m, report passing HZ. Do you require any additional assistance?
PIL: We will use the emergency slides so that the bomb disposal squad can get on board right NWA808.
Q: Who declared the bomb threat?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：西北808，管制，我们收到一个匿名电话，说你的飞机上有炸弹，报告你的意图。飞行员：西北808，这样的话，我们希望在你的机场降落。管制员：西北808，下降到4500米，过HZ后报，你需要其他援助吗？飞行员：我们需要使用紧急滑梯，这样排弹小组就可以上飞机了，西北808。问：谁宣布了炸弹威胁？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. An unknown person.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CSN205, port engine has some problems, request hold present position for 15 minutes.
CTL: CSN205, do you require any other assistance?
PIL: Negative, thanks, our engineer has just arrived, CSN205.
CTL: CSN205, roger, call again at 0012.
Q: According to the exchange, what should CSN205 do next?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京地面，南航205，左舷发动机故障，请求当前位置等待15分钟。管：南航205，还需要其它援助吗？飞：不需要，谢谢，我们的工程师刚赶到，南航205。管：南航205，收到，0012时再次呼叫。问：根据对话，南航205下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Hold and wait 15 minutes for engineer to arrive.
Remain in position while an engineer is called.
Remain in position for an engine check.
choicesZh: 原地等待，0012时呼叫工程师。
原地等待，等待工程师15分钟。
在当前位置呼叫工程师。
在当前位置检查发动机。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Remain in position for an engine check.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, ACA 342, port engine EGT exceeds limitation, suspect bird ingestion, request priority landing. C: ACA 342, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach, Runway 36R, you are number one.
Question: Why did the controller give Air Canada landing priority?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员（P）：武汉进近，ACA 342，左发排气温度（EGT）超过限制，怀疑吸入鸟类，请求优先着陆。管制员（C）：ACA 342，右转航向330，允许仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，36右跑道，你第一。问题：管制员为何给予加拿大航空优先着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Port engine overheat.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday Mayday Mayday, NWA987, engine fire after takeoff, require turn back emergency landing.
C: NWA987, roger Mayday. Turn right heading 090.
P: NWA987, we've lost use of all instruments and the fire is s till burning. We have runway 22 in sight and are turning to land immediately, out.
Q: What type of approach will Northwest 987 carry out?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，西北987，起飞后发动机起火，请求返场，紧急着陆。管制员：西北987，收到Mayday，右转航向090。飞行员：西北987，我们的仪表都不可用，现在火还在烧，我们看到了跑道22，正在返场紧急着陆。问：西北987将采用什么进近方式？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Visual Approach.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground control, CSN 378.
C: CSN 378, Ground, go ahead.
P: Our APU malfunctioned, request start No 2 engine at the bay, CSN 378.
C: CSN 378, when outbound Airbus 320 is clear behind you, one engine start at the bay approved, report when ready for pushback.
Question: What did CSN 378 request?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面管制，CSN 378。
C: CSN 378，地面，请讲。
P: 我们的APU发生故障，请求在停机位启动No 2发动机，CSN 378。
C: CSN 378，等你后方离场的Airbus 320通过后，批准在停机位启动一台发动机，准备推出时报告。
问题：CSN 378请求什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Start an engine at the bay.
choices: Start an engine at the bay.
choicesZh: 在停机位启动一台发动机。

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai, CES 324, good evening, maintaining 9500m, Squawk 3426.
C: CES 324, roger, offset right to L.
P: negative to offset, we are 737-500, we've no automatic tracking capability, CES 324.
C: CES 324, roger, fly planned route.
Question: Why did CES 324 not fly the offset?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 上海，CES 324，晚上好，保持9500m，应答机3426。
C: CES 324，收到，向右偏置至L。
P: 无法偏置，我们是737-500，没有自动航迹跟踪能力，CES 324。
C: CES 324，收到，按计划航路飞行。
问题：CES 324为什么没有偏置飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due to lack of installed equipment.
choices: They only had one GPS working.
They wanted to fly flight planned route.
Due to lack of installed equipment.
choicesZh: 他们只有一套GPS正常工作。
他们希望按计划航路飞行。

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 6183, heavy, a passenger is having problem in breathing due flow control, request delay takeoff.
C: CSN 6183, hold short of Runway 36L.
Question: Why did CSN 6183 heavy request delay takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京塔台，CSN 6183 heavy，一名乘客呼吸困难；由于流量管制，请求推迟起飞。
C: CSN 6183，在Runway 36L外等待。
问题：CSN 6183 heavy为什么请求推迟起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because a passenger is having problem in breathing.
choices: Because a passenger is having problem in breathing.
Because there is flow control in departure airspace.
Because there is wind shear warning message.
Because there is traffic on short final.
choicesZh: 因为一名乘客呼吸困难。
因为离场空域实施流量控制。
因为出现风切变警告信息。
因为有航空器在短五边。

cards.audioText:
P1: Take the next right.
P2: Are you sure, this is the runway. We must missed the turn. Tell Ground, we are holding for instruction.
C: CCA0011just... call you, you missed Tango, you may proceed down 5L, which is not active, turn left on E, turn right on S to the runway, turn not miss S, or you will be on active runway.
Question: What did the crew do wrong?
cards.audioTextZh:
P1: 在下一个路口右转。
P2: 你确定吗？这是跑道。我们一定错过了转弯处。告诉地面，我们正在等待指示。
C: CCA 0011，刚才……呼叫你，你错过了T。你可以沿未启用的Runway 5L继续前行，左转进入E，再右转进入S前往跑道。不要错过S，否则你将进入使用中的跑道。
问题：机组做错了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They missed the turn onto Tango.
choices: They are now on taxiway E.
They missed the turn onto Tango.
choicesZh: 他们错过了转入Tango滑行道的路口。

cards.audioText:
C: DAL 541, Wuhan Ground, your departure has to be delayed due to the weather. P: Wuhan Ground, how long is the delay? C: DAL 541, wait till the wind calms down a little. I will call you back when it drops to 10 knots or less.
Question: When will the controller contact the pilot again?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：DAL 541，武汉地面，由于天气原因，你的离场必须延误。飞行员：武汉地面，要延误多久？管制员：DAL 541，等风稍微减弱一些。风速降到10节或以下时，我会再次呼叫你。问题：管制员什么时候会再次联系飞行员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of above.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA16, we need to descend to 2500m due to pressurization problems.
C: ACA16, I can't descend you due to high ground. For descent turn right heading 020 degrees, then cleared to descend to 2000m at your discretion on 29.81 QNH.
Q: What did they have to do before they can descend?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：加航16，由于压力问题，我们需要下降到2500米。管制：加航16，由于地形，无法下降，右转航向020，然后可以自主下降到2000米，QNH29.81。问：他们下降前必须做什么？
choices: Cleared to 2000 meters at pilot discretion.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Turn to heading 020 degrees.

cards.audioText:
PIL: UAL350, we can't hold any longer, we have serious ill passenger on board.
CTL: UAL350, leave holding pattern, fly heading 050.
PIL: Heading 050, UAL350, request first aid after landing.
CTL: Roger, UAL350.
Q: What will be the immediate need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：美联航350，不能继续等待，飞机上有严重生病的乘客。管：美联航350，离开等待航线，航向050。飞：航向050，美联航350，请求着陆后提供急救。管：收到，美联航350。问：飞机着陆后急需什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, AFR966, intercept distress call from DLH124. DLH124 has fuel emergency with 15 minutes endurance, request landing priority. The aircraft's position is 15 miles east at 9000 feet.
C: AFR966, roger, mayday, break, break.
Q: Which of the following statements is true?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，法航966，截获汉莎航路124的遇险信号，汉莎124燃油短缺，只有15分钟的续航时间了，请求优先着陆，飞机目前位置在以东15海里，高度9000英尺。管制员：法航966，收到Mayday，断开，断开。问：以下哪个表述是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. DLH124 has fuel trouble.

cards.audioText:
A: I'm planning a flight to Blue yard airport, what about the weather there?
B: Captain, the weather is marginal, a thunderstorm might be there, there are some cumulonimbus clouds building, our weather radar shows some cells, a squall line must be developing at the head of the front.
Q: Which of the following words is not involved in the weather?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：我计划飞往Blue yard机场，那边的天气如何？
B：机长，天气情况很差，机场可能有雷暴，机场上空积雨云正在形成，我们的气象雷达显示有雷暴单体，锋前肯定有飑线正在形成。
问：以下哪个词不包含在此天气中？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Quarrel.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 1347, stop taxiing. A Boeing 747, mistakenly turn right onto the taxiway B. You'll have to wait there till I send a tug to tow it beyond the next intersection. P: Roger, stopping CSN 1347.
Question: why did the controller ask CSN 1347 to stop taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员（C）：CSN 1347，停止滑行。一架波音747误右转进入 B滑行道。你必须在那里等待，直到我派牵引车将其拖到下一个交叉点之外。飞行员（P）：收到，CSN 1347停止滑行。问题：管制员为何要求CSN 1347停止滑行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. An aircraft mistakenly blocked the taxiway.
choices: An aircraft mistakenly blocked the taxiway.
CSN 1347 taxied to a wrong way.
An unreported vehicle was on Taxiway B.
choicesZh: 一架飞机误占了滑行道。
B滑行道上有一辆未报告的车辆。

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Tower, CCA 106, we heard loud noises coming out from the starboard engine, the instrument shows high EGT, request taxi back for maintenance check.
C: CCA 106, taxi via taxiway A, A5 and K to stand K38 for check.
Question: Why did CCA 106 request taxi back?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉塔台，CCA 106，我们听到右侧发动机发出巨响，仪表显示EGT高，请求滑行返回进行维修检查。
