C: CCA 106，经滑行道A、A5和K滑行至K38停机位检查。
问题：CCA 106为什么请求滑行返回？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due high EGT indication of starboard engine.
choices: Due loud noise coming out from aft toilet.
Due high EGT indication of starboard engine.
Due high oil temperature of starboard engine.
Due loud noise coming out from front cabin.
choicesZh: 由于后部洗手间传出巨响。
由于右发排气温度指示过高。
由于右发滑油温度过高。

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Beijing Control, SIA442, Boeing777, fire in the rear toilet, descending 3600m, request emergency landing at Beijing airport, position 50 miles west of Beijing, heading 060.
C: SIA442, roger mayday, break, break, all stations on 126.3, stop transmitting, mayday.
Q: What is the position of SIA442?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，北京区调，新航442，波音777，后方厕所起火，下降到3600米，请求在北京机场紧急着陆，目前在北京以西50英里，航向060。管制员：新航442，收到Mayday，断开，断开，所有各台停止发话，有遇险活动。问：新航442的位置在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 50 miles west of Beijing.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, GBD, we can't remove the warning of takeoff configuration, there must be something wrong, we have to taxi back for check.
C: GBD, taxi via taxiway C and P to Gate 2, caution, there is an aircraft skidded off the taxiway near the intersection.
Question: What problem did GBD experience?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，GBD，我们无法消除起飞构型警告，肯定存在问题，必须滑行返回检查。
C: GBD，经滑行道C和P滑行至Gate 2，注意，交叉口附近有一架航空器滑出滑行道。
问题：GBD遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They cannot reset the warning of takeoff configuration.
choices: They cannot reset the warning of landing configuration.
They cannot reset the warning of takeoff configuration.
They have something wrong with the takeoff configuration.
They have something wrong with the undercarriage and flaps.
choicesZh: 他们无法复位着陆构型警告。
他们无法复位起飞构型警告。
他们的起飞构型存在问题。
他们的起落架和襟翼存在问题。

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Shanghai Approach, AFR230 heavy, request immediate landing, we were hit by a light aircraft.
CTL: AFR230, roger MAYDAY. Maintain heading, you are number one. Confirm current condition.
PIL: Left aileron is out of control due torn-off wing tip, AFR230.
Q: According to the dialogue, which part of the aircraft was hit?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，上海进近，法航230重型，请求立即降落，我们和一架小型飞机相撞了。管：法航230，收到MAYDAY。保持航向，你是第一个。确认当前状况。飞：由于翼尖脱落，左副翼失控，法航230。问：根据对话，飞机哪部分被撞了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The left wing tip.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 330, Beijing Control, radio check. You did not report over LADEX as instructed. CSN 330, Beijing Control. CSN 330, if you copy, squawk ident. CSN 330, transmitting on 121.5.
Question: What is happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：CSN 330，北京区调，无线电检查。你飞越LADEX时没有按指令报告。CSN 330，北京区调。CSN 330，如能听到，请按应答机识别键。CSN 330，正在121.5频率上发射。问题：空中交通管制员与飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, ACA121, port engine failure, 5 miles west of HG, 8900m, heading 030, request return to Beijing.
CTL: ACA121, roger MAYDAY, radar vectors to runway 01, turn right direct to HG and descend to 6900m, you'll be number one.
Q: How many meters should ACA121 descend?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京进近，加航121，左舷发动机故障，HG西5海里，8900米，航向030，请求返回北京。管：加航121，收到MAYDAY。雷达引导至跑道01，左转直飞HG后下降到6900米，你是第一个。问：加航121应该下降多少米？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 2000 meters.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, cleared for takeoff.
PIL: Taking off, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, stop immediately, I say again, stop immediately, flames coming from left main gear.
PIL: Stopping and activating escape slides, request emergency services, CCA102.
Q: Why did the pilot activate escape slides?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，可以起飞。飞：起飞，国航102.管：国航102，立即终止，重复一遍，立即终止，左主起落架冒烟。飞：停下，打开逃生滑梯，请求紧急服务，国航102。问：为什么飞行员打开逃生滑梯？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Main gear on fire.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Manchester Ground, UAL94, we have a hydraulic problem, and have lost nose wheel steering. We will have to hold position and request you send us a tug to take us back to the Gate.
CTL: Roger, UAL94, standby.
CTL: UAL94, suggest you shut down your engines, there is a tug on this way.
PIL: UAL94, roger.
Q: What problem does UAL94 have?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：曼彻斯特地面，美联航94，飞机出现液压问题，前轮无法转弯。我们在原地等待，请求拖轮将飞机拖回机位。管：收到，美联航94，稍等。管：美联航94，建议关闭发动机，拖轮将就位。飞：美联航94，收到。问：美联航94遇到了什么问题？
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A hydraulic problem.

cards.audioText:
P: NW968, reaching holding point 29, request return to stand, the brake is overheating.
C: Roger, NW968, turning to holding bay, take first convenient left turn taxiway J.
P: Left turn on the taxiway J, NW968.
Q: Which taxiway is NW968 to use?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：西北968，到达等待点29，请求返回机坪，刹车过热。管制员：收到，西北968，滑回机坪，左转进入滑行道J。飞行员：左转进入滑行道J，西北968。问：西北968使用的滑行道是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Taxiway J.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Tower, go around, I say again go around, the preceding aircraft is unable to vacate the runway.
PIL: Going around, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, orbit right, runway still blocked.
PIL: Wilco, CCA102.
Q: Why should CCA102 make missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航102，北京塔台，复飞，再说一遍，复飞，前机无法脱离跑道。飞：复飞，国航102。管：国航102，右转机动，跑道仍不可用。飞：收到，国航102。问：国航102为什么要复飞？
choices: There was debris on the runway.
Another aircraft was taking off on the runway.
Another aircraft was on the runway.
choicesZh: 跑道上有其它飞机正在起飞。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Another aircraft was on the runway.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CES328, TCAS indicates opposite traffic climbing towards us. Can you confirm that traffic's intended level?
CTL: CES328, roger. That traffic is climbing to FL310, left converging and will cross from your 11 o'clock.
Q: Which is NOT correct according to the passage?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞：北京区调，东方328，TCAS显示有相对活动正在上升，你能确认那架飞机的目标高度层吗？管：东方328，收到。那架飞机正上升到高度层310，左侧汇入并且从你11点钟方向穿过。问：根据以上内容，哪项是不正确的？
choices: The traffic appeared to be climbing towards CES328.
The traffic was to the right of CES328.
The traffic would pass under CES328 without incident.
choicesZh: 活动似乎在朝东方328上升。
活动会从东方328下方安全通过。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The traffic was to the right of CES328.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA1538, Beijing Tower, stop immediately, the B737 ahead of you is stuck on the taxiway due to hydraulic trouble. We'll have you pushed back, so that you can resume taxiing via the southern taxiway.
Q: Why does the controller ask the pilot to stop?
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：国航1538，北京塔台，立即停止，由于液压故障，你前方的B737卡在滑行道半道上了。我们将把你推回，这样你可以沿着南边的滑行道滑行了。问：管制员为什么让飞行员停止？
choices: He is taxiing in wrong taxiways.
choicesZh: 他滑到错误的滑行道了。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The aircraft ahead has problems.

cards.audioText:
P: Melbourne Tower, QFA344, hold at holing point runway 29 ready for departure.
C: QFA344 hold at holding point runway 29 for a few minutes. The runway is still blocked by a Cessna.
Q: Why does the controller ask the pilot to hold?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员：墨尔本塔台，澳航344，在跑道29等待点等待，准备好起飞了。管制员：在跑道29等待点再等几分钟，跑道被一架塞斯纳挡住了。问：为什么管制员让飞行员等待？
choices: Because there is an airplane on final.
Because an aircraft blocked the runway.
Because there is a tug on the runway.
Because the vehicle blocked the runway.
choicesZh: 因为一架航空器挡住了跑道。
因为跑道上有一辆拖车。
因为一辆汽车挡住了跑道。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because an aircraft blocked the runway.
